th.689f48de3b47a5cc734addec:
You don’t have time to run back and forth chasing down some password. So you decide to act.

You lunge forward, shoving the man out of your way. He clearly didn’t expect that kind of boldness and doesn’t react right away. You sprint ahead, slipping through the gate of the outpost.
th.689f4912e84e2561e5645f50:
You keep going, bursting through the gate.

Ahead of you lies a tiny courtyard, and just beyond it the bridge to the other side. Your goal is so close!

But the outpost isn’t guarded by just the man you left behind. In the courtyard, a few others are playing cards. The moment they spot you, they leap to their feet and grab their weapons.

— Where the hell do you think you’re going?! — one of them curses, then whistles sharply.
th.689f49e9948b799c4f33d808:
You have no choice but to go all in.

Like a berserker, you dash forward, yelling, half to scare the bandits, half to steel yourself.

But you only make it halfway across the courtyard.
th.689f49fb899498a7be9cac58:
You freeze, unsure what to do. Run back? No, that’s stupid. Forward? You don’t even have a weapon!

Not that you get the chance to decide.
th.689f4a07239f2965c3c6c828:
You decide to turn back. Clearly, you’ve overestimated yourself.

You raise your hands, force a guilty smile, and step back. You don’t even manage to say a word in your defense.
th.689f4bc7037746c8a7d97cf4:
Suddenly, you hear a faint whistle, and a moment later something slams into your shoulder. The pain feels like someone’s trying to rip your arm clean off. Instinctively, you clutch the wound with your hand.

An arrow hits you.
th.689f4c18548d732e5c77d7b4:
But before you can even catch your breath, another arrow strikes you from the other side. This one buries itself in your thigh, and you stumble, dropping to one knee.

You scream like a cornered animal, begging them to stop, but the third arrow punches straight through your skull.

You collapse lifelessly. On your nameless grave they’ll write “Brave, but foolish”.
th.689f534cb15f1c44c281c955: You pull a gold coin from your pouch and toss it neatly into the dark mouth of the well. A second later you expect to hear a splash, but nothing comes. Is it really that deep?
th.689f535ba0d559d825f5fc89: Strange. Better play it safe and step back.
th.689f55668f28d43762e2a816:
You shrug and toss another coin into the well. This time, something shiny shoots back up and smacks you square in the forehead before bouncing back down.

Now you hear a splash.

The well just threw your coin at you! Or whatever lives inside it did.
th.689f5623416da0ee0dccbce0: Better not risk it again. Play it safe.
th.689f5649a4982cf97fab12ab: Figure out what happened. Curiosity wins!
th.689f565d0e328e5fac59c293:
You peer inside and see nothing but darkness. Deep, deep below, you can hear water splashing. Suddenly, a strange ringing sound rises from the depths.

You lean lower, trying to catch sight of its source.
th.689f569a18e77852b9b84b0f:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.
th.689f56ae130f4eb0fbb5ac9e:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.

ch.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
终于，你抵达了河对岸。回望渡口，身后没有人依依不舍地为你送行。这倒也好，你再也不想看到那些强盗们的狰狞面容。
  你至今仍不明白为什么自己一下子就参悟了暗号。想必是主赐予你的急中生智——而这意味着他要你安然抵达塔格勒，意味着你的使命至关重要。这份觉悟驱使你继续前行。
ch.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: 眼前的沼泽绵延不绝，太阳仿佛躲了起来，穿入云中不肯露面。你步伐轻盈地向前走去，所有的艰难困苦都已留在身后——塔格勒已经近在咫尺。
ch.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: 眼前的沼泽绵延不绝，太阳仿佛躲了起来，穿入云中不肯露面。你向前走着，不时微微蹙起眉头，身上的伤口仍然疼痛不止，因此赶路速度要慢上一些，但眼下所有的艰难困苦都已留在身后——塔格勒已经近在咫尺。
ch.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: 你不停往前走。周围的沼泽地千篇一律，让你渐渐分不清方位。半个小时过去了，一个小时过去了。你翻开地图才发现，按照路途你早就该踏上坚实的干了，而在此刻，沼泽却在你的面前无尽延伸开去。
ch.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: 你叹了口气，继续前行。或许地图标错了，又或者你迷失了方向。但只要沿着路走下去，迟早会抵达某个地方。对吧？……
ch.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
你停下脚步，环顾四周。肯定是在某个地方走错路了，必须原路返回。你转身朝相反方向走去。
  但又走了半小时后，仍然没有看到渡口与哨所的踪影，一小时后，眼前仍然是沼泽。焦虑开始在你的心底翻涌，这到底是怎么回事？
ch.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
终于，你看见前方有间小屋，便停下了脚步。周围是无法穿越的沼泽。一个人怎么可能独自在这里生存？
  小屋看似打理得井井有条，但不知为何……透着一股不属于这个世界的气息。
ch.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
这栋透着神秘气息的屋子还挺可爱，但现在不是插手不相干事情的时候。你必须尽快抵达塔格勒。
  你绕过房子继续前行。
ch.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
你继续向前走去，走了又走。
  道路如窄窄的缎带向前延伸开来，在沼泽丘陵间蜿蜒盘旋。前方出现了一处建筑，你走上前去……
ch.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
……你突然意识到，这竟是同一栋房子。甚至你上次还是从同一面靠近的它。难道你迷路了？但你记得自己是直直向前走的，根本没有回头！
  这绝对是某种魔法，而房子的主人正想让你进去。
ch.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
门微微敞开着，你推门而入。
  首先映入眼帘的是一具尸体，几乎横卧在门槛上的。接着你注意到了天花板上悬挂着草药，你意识到这座屋子的主人——或者说前主人——是一位女巫。
ch.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: 让这屋子见鬼去吧！该动身了。
ch.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: 最好还是先仔细打量打量这座屋子。
ch.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
你正要离开，继续在沼泽中徘徊寻找出口，突然一股力量将你拉了回来。
  “帮我……”
  你浑身发抖地环顾四周。那声低语，你绝对听见了！但周围空无一人，只有……你望向那具尸体。寒毛倒竖的你意识到，似乎有人——或者说某种东西——不愿轻易放你离开。你别无选择。
ch.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: 最好还是先仔细打量打量这座屋子。
ch.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
你继续往里走。这间小屋显然只供一人居住：你只发现一张床铺，一套木制餐具。这里的一切都浸润着魔法气息，却意外地温馨舒适。没有装满可疑药剂的怪异大锅，没有邪恶符文，没有黑猫或公鸡。若不是它矗立在沼泽树桩之上，你根本分辨不出这里与普通的乡间小屋有任何不同。
  你没发现什么有趣的东西。
ch.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: 你靠近了尸体，停在了旁边。一名年轻女子面朝下躺着，一把剑直直地刺在她的背上。没人会主动将武器留在尸体上。你盯着那把杀人武器，意识到这把剑似乎价值不菲。
ch.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: 你上前抓住剑柄。突然间，掌心被一种前所未有的冰冷所刺痛，仿佛被烧灼了一样。你下意识地缩回双手。
ch.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: 你决定将剑留在原处。在你的内心深处突然浮现了一个念头，让你不愿继续玷污这个陌生人的尸体。或许你该把她移走，葬在院子里。
ch.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: 但就在你弯腰之前，一个幽灵突然在你眼前从尸体上升起。你猛地退后，不知所措。
ch.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
你无视警告。前方就是通往塔格勒的道路了，而先前渡口的那群强盗绝非唯一一帮趁着城市虚弱，守军自顾不暇时占山为王的匪徒。毕竟你需要的不是冰冷的尸体，而是那柄剑。
  你再次抓住剑柄，咬紧牙关抵御住寒意将剑拔出。剑身从尸体中滑落。
ch.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
突然，一股力量将你震飞出去。你撞上了墙壁，喘着粗气爬起身来。眼前，被杀害的女子的亡魂缓缓升起。屋子内顿时寒气逼人，你开始瑟瑟发抖。到底是控制不住的寒战，抑或是恐惧？
  亡魂的面容因愤怒而扭曲。
  — 你竟敢亵渎无辜者的遗体？！
ch.68776b3279ae8e72b6a5a627: 我只是动了下那把剑而已！
ch.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: 别靠过来，你个吓死人不偿命的鬼！
ch.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: 幽灵大笑起来。她的笑声在屋子里回荡，令你脊背发凉。你该怎么办？
ch.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
幽灵并没有回话，只是微笑着。在你眼前的已经不是一具尸体，而是一位年轻女子。但千万别昏了头，你提醒自己，就算幻化成少女的模样，恶灵终究是恶灵。
  你会怎么做？
ch.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
你决定冒险一试。屋子的出口近在咫尺，你完全可以冲出去。
  你猛地跳起来冲向敞开的门。
  砰——门在你面前哐当关上。你使劲拉门把手，却纹丝不动。
  — 别跑。你在我的地盘上，你是逃不掉的。
  你转身面对那个幽灵。突然间，你似乎意识到了什么。
ch.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
你僵立在原地，凝视着那各幽灵。她微微歪头，向你倾身靠近。
  — 还好你不打算逃跑。
  她的声音在你脑海某处回荡。你没有移开视线。
  — 反正你现在是在我的地盘上。
  突然间，你恍然察觉到了什么。
ch.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
但你的话语只是从幽灵身旁掠过。你看见从她身体延伸出霜花一般的轨迹，直指你而来。那女子的幽灵咆哮着扑向你。顷刻间，她半透明的手掌刺入你的胸膛。
  你本以为会感到疼痛，但一秒过去，又一秒过去……却毫无反应。幽灵猛地退开，再度悬浮在尸体上方。
ch.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
鬼魂露出微笑，一股焦虑感扑面而来。她为何在笑？她的攻击根本没成功！你明明还活着……
  突然，一股剧痛刺穿胸膛。你踉跄后退，痛楚蔓延至背脊与手臂。幽灵的笑容也愈发狰狞。
  — 现在呢？喜欢吗？
  你跪倒在地，耳边只有她那空灵的声音还在回响。此刻呼吸已成奢望。你还没明白到底发生了什么，你的意识就已经消散得无影无踪。
  你的生命，也随之消逝。
ch.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: 我没法走出沼泽是你干的吗？
ch.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
那个幽灵女孩点了点头。
  — 在我放你走之前，你别想离开这里。
  你意识到她并没有在说大话，但她营造这一切又是为了什么呢？
ch.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— 只要你帮我，我就会放你走，— 幽灵的形态忽地清晰起来，一会又宛如波纹般闪烁，如同有石块投入湖面般荡漾不已。
  你不由自主地瞥向她身下躺着的尸体。
ch.68776c901d977782c497b92d: 但我好像帮不上什么忙。
ch.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — 我说的是我自己！不是这具躯壳。— 幽灵顿了顿。你猛地一惊，只见她脸上掠过嗜血的狞笑，但下一秒表情又恢复平静。看来她厌恶无谓的提问。最好记住这一点。

cz.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Konečně se dostáváš na druhou stranu řeky. Ohlédneš se zpět na přechod. Nikdo tě nevyprovází, a to je dobře. To poslední, co chceš, je vidět zase ty ksichty banditů.
Pořád nechápeš, jak jsi znal heslo. Určitě ti Pán požehnal tajnými znalostmi. To znamená, že chce, abys dosáhl Targradu. To znamená, že tvoje práce je důležitá. Toto pochopení tě žene vpřed.
cz.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Před tebou se rozprostírají bažiny. Slunce se čím dál častěji schovává za mraky. Jdeš vpřed, našlapuješ lehce. Určitě už máš všechny potíže za sebou. Targrad už není daleko.
cz.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Před tebou se rozprostírají bažiny. Slunce se čím dál častěji schovává za mraky. Jdeš vpřed a mírně se mračíš. Všechny ty škrábance bolí, takže se pohybuješ pomaleji, než jsi plánoval. Ale to je v pohodě: určitě už máš všechny potíže za sebou. Targrad už není daleko.
cz.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: Jdeš a jdeš. Bažiny kolem vypadají tak podobně, že přestáváš vědět, kde přesně jsi. Uplyne půl hodiny. Uplyne hodina. Podíváš se na mapu a uvědomíš si, že už jsi měl dosáhnout pevné, suché země, ale bažiny nekončí.
cz.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: Povzdechneš si a jdeš dál. Možná je ta mapa nepřesná, možná jsi ztratil cestu. Ale dřív nebo pozdějc někam dorazíš, když zůstaneš na cestě. Že jo?...
cz.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
Zastavíš se a rozhlédneš se. Určitě jsi někde špatně zahnul. Musíš se vrátit a začít znova. Otočíš se a jdeš pryč.
Ale po půl hodině nevidíš žádnou základnu, ani po hodině. Uvnitř tebe narůstá úzkost. Co se to kurva děje?
cz.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Konečně před sebou vidíš chýši a zastavíš se. Obklopují ji neprostupné bažiny. Jak tady někdo může sám přežít?
Ten dům vypadá udržovaně, ale tak nějak... nadpozemsky.
cz.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
Ten dům je roztomilý a tajemný, ale teď není čas strkat nos do věcí, které ti nepatří. Musíš se co nejdřív dostat do Targradu.
Projdeš kolem domu a pokračuješ dál.
cz.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
Jdeš. A jdeš. A jdeš.
Cesta se táhne před tebou jako úzká stuha, vinoucí se mezi bažinatými hroudami. Před sebou vidíš stavbu a přibližuješ se...
cz.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
...a uvědomíš si, že je to ten samý dům. Dokonce jsi se k němu přiblížil ze stejné strany jako minule. Že by ses ztratil? Ale pamatuješ si, že jsi šel po naprosto rovné cestě!
Tohle je určitě nějaká magie. A její majitel chce, abys vstoupil do domu.
cz.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
Dveře jsou pootevřené. Strčíš do nich a vstoupíš dovnitř.
První, čeho si všimneš, je tělo ležící téměř na prahu. Pak - bylinky visící ze stropu. Uvědomíš si, že tady žije nějaká čarodějnice. Skloníš pohled k tělu. Nebo spíš žila.
cz.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
Už se chystáš odejít a pokračovat v bloudění bažinami při hledání východu, když tě náhle nějaká síla zatáhne zpět.
"Pomoz mi..."
Zatřeseš se a rozhlédneš se. Šepot, určitě jsi ho slyšel! Ale nikdo kolem není, jen... Podíváš se na tělo. Naskakuje ti husí kůže. Zdá se, že někdo - nebo něco - tě nechce jen tak snadno pustit. Prostě nemáš na vybranou.
cz.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
Pohybuješ se dál. Chýše je jasně určená pro jednu osobu: najdeš jen jednu postel, jednu sadu dřevěného nádobí. Všechno tady je prosycené magií a nečekaně domáckým pohodlím. Žádné podivné kotle s podezřelými lektvary, žádné ďábelské znaky, žádné černé kočky nebo kohouti. Kdyby tahle chýše nestála na bažinatých pařezech, nerozeznal bys ji od žádného běžného vesnického domu.
Nic zajímavého nenacházíš.
cz.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: Přistoupíš a stojíš přímo nad mrtvolou. Mladá žena leží obličejem dolů, z jejích zad trčí meč. Nikdo by dobrovolně nenechal svou zbraň v mrtvole. Podíváš se na meč a uvědomíš si, že je dost drahý.
cz.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: Přistoupíš a chytíš rukojeť meče. Náhle ti dlaně pálí chlad, jaký jsi nikdy předtím necítil. Reflexivně stáhneš ruce zpět.
cz.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Možná je lepší to už nezkoušet.
cz.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: Rozhodneš se nechat meč na místě. Něco v tobě se brání myšlence dalšího zohavování těla cizí ženy. Možná bys ji měl dokonce přemístit a pohřbít na dvoře.
cz.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: Ale než se stačíš sehnout, z těla se přímo před tebou zvedne duch. Uskočíš, nejistý, co dělat.
cz.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
Ignoruješ varování. Před tebou leží cesta do Targradu. Určitě banditi z přechodu nejsou jediní, kdo využili slabosti města. Potřebuješ ten meč víc než studenou mrtvolu.
Znovu chytíš rukojeť, zatneš zuby proti chladu a vytáhneš meč. Vysmekne se z těla.
cz.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Náhle tě vlna síly odhodí zpět. Narazíš do zdi a popadneš dech. Před tebou se vznáší duch zavražděné ženy. V chýši je taková zima, že se začínáš třást. Nebo je to strach?
Tvář ducha je zkřivená vztekem.
— Jak se opovažuješ zneuctít tělo nevinné oběti?!
cz.68776b3279ae8e72b6a5a627: Já si jen vzal ten meč!
cz.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: Duch se směje. Její smích se ozývá chýší a posílá ti mráz po zádech. Co uděláš?
cz.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
Duch neodpovídá, jen se usmívá. Nevidíš mrtvolu, ale mladou ženu. Ale nenech se oklamat, připomínáš si, zlý duch zůstává zlým duchem.
Co uděláš?
cz.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
Rozhodneš se zariskovat. Východ z chýše je velmi blízko, můžeš to stihnout.
Skočíš na nohy a vyrazíš k otevřeným dveřím.
Bang - dveře se zavřou přímo před tebou. Zatáhneš za kliku, ale ta se ani nehne.
— Neběž. Stejně se ti to nepodaří. Jsi na mém území.
Otočíš se k duchovi. Náhle si něco uvědomíš.
cz.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
Zůstaneš stát jako přikovaný a zíráš na ducha. Mírně nakloní hlavu a natáhne se k tobě.
— Je dobře, že jsi neutekl.
Její hlas se ozývá někde v tvé hlavě. Neodvracíš pohled.
— Stejně jsi na mém území.
Náhle si něco uvědomíš.
cz.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
Ale tvá slova ducha míjejí. Vidíš, jak mráz kreslí cesty od jejího těla směrem k tobě. Ženský duch zařve a vrhne se na tebe. Během vteřiny se její poloprůhledná ruka zanoří do tvé hrudi.
Očekáváš bolest, ale uplyne vteřina, pak další... a nic se nestane. Duch ucukne a znovu se vznáší nad tělem.
cz.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Cha! To je všechno, na co se zmohla?
cz.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
Duch se usměje a zasáhne tě vlna úzkosti. Proč se usmívá? Její útok nevyšel! Jsi naživu a…
Náhle ti hrudí probodne bolest. Zavrávoráš. Bolest vyzařuje do zad a paže. Úsměv ducha se rozšiřuje.
— A co teď? Líbí se ti to?
Slyšíš její nadpozemský hlas, jak padáš na kolena. Dýchání je teď nemožné. Sotva chápeš, co se stalo, než tě opustí vědomí.
Stejně jako tvůj život.
cz.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Je to tvoje vina, že se nemůžu dostat z bažin?
cz.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
Dušička přikývne.
— Neodejdeš odsud, dokud ti to nedovolím.
A uvědomíš si, že nelže. Ale proč to všechno potřebuje?
cz.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Pomoz mi, a nechám tě jít, — duch se chvěje mezi jasností a vlněním, jako jezero rozrušené hozeným kamenem.
Mimovolně pohlédneš na tělo ležící pod ní.
cz.68776c901d977782c497b92d: Nevypadá to, že bych ti mohl s čímkoliv pomoct.
cz.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — Myslím sebe! Ne to tělo. — duch se na okamžik promění. Uskočíš, když jí tváří bleskne krvežíznivé zavrčení, ale o vteřinu později je její výraz opět klidný. Zdá se, že nemá ráda zbytečné otázky. Radši si to zapamatuj.

en.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.
en.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
en.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, frowning slightly. All your scratches hurt, so you move slower than planned. But it’s fine: surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
en.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.
en.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..
en.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
You stop and look around. Surely you turned the wrong way somewhere. You need to go back and start over. You turn around and head away.
But you don’t see the outpost after half an hour, nor after an hour. Anxiety rises inside you. What the hell is going on?
en.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Finally, you see a hut ahead and stop. Impassable swamps surround it. How could anyone survive here alone?
The house looks well-kept, but somehow… otherworldly.
en.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
The house is cute and mysterious, but now is not the time to meddle in things that aren’t yours. You need to reach Targrad as soon as possible.
You pass the house and continue onward.
en.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
You walk. And walk. And walk.
The road stretches ahead like a narrow ribbon, winding among swampy hummocks. You see a structure ahead and approach…
en.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
…and realize that it is the same house. You even approached it from the same side as last time. Could you have gotten lost? But you remember walking on an absolutely straight road!
This is definitely some kinnd of magic. And its owner wants you to enter the house.
en.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.
The first thing you notice is a body lying almost on the threshold. Then — herbs hanging from the ceiling. You realize some witch lives here. You lower your gaze to the body. Or, rather, lived here.
en.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: To hell with it! Time to leave.
en.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Better examine the house more carefully.
en.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
en.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
en.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
en.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
en.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
en.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
en.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
en.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
en.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
en.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
en.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter!
en.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
en.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?
en.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
en.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
en.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
en.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Ha! Is that all you've got?
en.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
en.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
en.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
en.68776c7cc56cd8dae883c911: What do you want from me?
en.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
en.68776c901d977782c497b92d: It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything.
en.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

fr.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finalement, vous atteignez l’autre rive de la rivière. Vous jetez un regard en arrière vers le point de passage. Personne ne vous raccompagne, et c’est tant mieux. La dernière chose que vous souhaitez, c’est revoir le visage de ces bandits.

Vous ne comprenez toujours pas comment vous avez connu le mot de passe. C’est sûrement le Seigneur qui vous a accordé ce savoir secret. Cela signifie qu’Il veut que vous atteigniez Targrad. Cela signifie que votre mission est importante. Cette certitude vous pousse à avancer.
fr.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Devant vous, les marais s’étendent à perte de vue. Le soleil se cache de plus en plus souvent derrière les nuages. Vous avancez prudemment. Tous les obstacles sont sûrement derrière vous. Targrad n’est plus très loin.
fr.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Devant vous, les marais s’étendent à perte de vue. Le soleil se cache de plus en plus souvent derrière les nuages. Vous avancez en fronçant légèrement les sourcils. Toutes vos égratignures vous font souffrir, vous progressez donc plus lentement que prévu. Mais ce n’est pas grave : tous les obstacles sont sûrement derrière vous. Targrad n’est plus très loin.
fr.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: Vous marchez encore et encore. Les marais autour de vous se ressemblent tant que vous finissez par ne plus savoir où vous vous trouvez exactement. Une demi-heure passe. Puis une heure. Vous regardez la carte et réalisez que vous auriez déjà dû atteindre un terrain sec et solide, mais les marais ne s’arrêtent pas.
fr.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: Vous soupirez et continuez d’avancer. Peut-être que la carte est inexacte, peut-être vous êtes-vous égaré. Mais tôt ou tard, vous finirez bien par arriver quelque part si vous restez sur le chemin. N’est-ce pas ?
fr.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
Vous vous arrêtez et regardez autour de vous. Vous avez forcément pris un mauvais tournant quelque part. Il faut revenir en arrière et recommencer. Vous faites demi-tour et repartez.
Mais vous ne voyez pas l’avant-poste, ni après une demi-heure, ni après une heure. L’angoisse monte en vous. Qu’est-ce que c’est que ce bordel ?
fr.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Finalement, vous apercevez une cabane devant vous et vous vous arrêtez. Des marais infranchissables l’entourent. Comment quelqu’un peut-il survivre ici seul ?

La maison a l’air bien entretenue, mais d’une certaine manière… irréelle.
fr.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
La maison est mignonne et mystérieuse, mais ce n’est pas le moment de vous mêler de ce qui ne vous regarde pas. Vous devez atteindre Targrad au plus vite.
Vous dépassez la maison et vous continuez votre route.
fr.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
Vous marchez. Et vous marchez. Et vous marchez.
La route s’étire devant vous comme un ruban étroit, serpentant entre les buttes marécageuses. Vous apercevez une bâtisse et vous vous en approchez…
fr.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
…et vous réalisez que c’est la même maison. Vous vous en êtes même approché du même côté que la dernière fois. Vous vous êtes perdu ? Pourtant, vous vous souvenez avoir marché sur une route parfaitement droite !
C’est clairement une sorte de magie. Et son propriétaire veut que vous entriez dans la maison.
fr.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
La porte est entrouverte. Vous la poussez et entrez.
La première chose que vous remarquez, c’est un corps presque sur le seuil. Ensuite, des herbes suspendues au plafond. Vous comprenez qu’une sorcière vit ici. Vous baissez les yeux vers le corps. Ou plutôt… vivait ici.
fr.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: Au diable tout ça ! Il est temps de partir.
fr.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Mieux vaut examiner la maison plus attentivement.
fr.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
Vous vous apprêtez à repartir et à continuer d’errer dans les marais à la recherche d’une sortie, quand soudain une force vous tire en arrière.
« À l’aide… »
Vous frissonnez et regardez autour de vous. Un chuchotement, vous l’avez bien entendu ! Mais il n’y a personne, seulement… Vous regardez le corps. Un frisson vous parcourt l’échine. On dirait que quelqu’un, ou quelque chose, «ne veut pas vous laisser partir si facilement. Vous n’avez tout simplement pas le choix.
fr.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Mieux vaut examiner la maison plus attentivement.
fr.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
Vous avancez. La cabane est clairement faite pour une seule personne : vous ne trouvez qu’un lit, qu’un seul service de vaisselle en bois. Tout ici est imprégné de magie et d’un confort étonnamment chaleureux. Pas de chaudrons suspects, pas de marques démoniaques, pas de chats noirs ni de coqs. Si cette cabane n’était pas posée sur des souches dans les marais, vous ne la distingueriez pas d’une maison de village ordinaire.
Vous ne trouvez rien d’intéressant.
fr.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: Vous vous approchez et vous vous tenez juste au-dessus du cadavre. Une jeune femme est allongée face contre terre, une épée plantée dans le dos. Personne ne laisserait volontairement son arme dans un corps. Vous regardez l’épée et réalisez qu’elle a l’air plutôt chère.
fr.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: Vous saisissez la poignée de l’épée. Soudain, vos paumes sont brûlées par un froid comme vous n’en avez jamais ressenti. Par réflexe, vous retirez vos mains.
fr.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: Vous décidez de laisser l’épée en place. Quelque chose en vous refuse l’idée de profaner davantage le corps d’une inconnue. Peut-être devriez-vous même la déplacer et l’enterrer dans la cour.
fr.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: Mais avant même que vous puissiez vous pencher, un fantôme s’élève du corps, juste devant vous. Vous reculez, sans savoir quoi faire.
fr.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
Vous ignorez l’avertissement. Devant vous se trouve le chemin vers Targrad. Les bandits du passage ne sont sûrement pas les seuls à profiter de la faiblesse de la ville. Vous avez plus besoin de l’épée que de ce corps froid.
Vous attrapez de nouveau la poignée, serrez les dents contre le froid et tirez. L’épée glisse hors du corps.
fr.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Soudain, une vague de force vous projette en arrière. Vous heurtez le mur et reprenez votre souffle. Devant vous, le fantôme de la femme assassinée se redresse. La cabane devient si glaciale que vous vous mettez à trembler. Ou est-ce la peur ?
Le visage du fantôme est tordu de rage.
— Comment oses-tu profaner le corps d’une victime innocente ?!
fr.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: Le fantôme rit. Son rire résonne dans la cabane, vous glaçant jusqu’aux os. Que faites-vous ?
fr.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
Le fantôme ne répond pas, il se contente de sourire. Vous ne voyez pas un cadavre, mais une jeune femme. Mais ne vous laissez pas tromper, vous vous rappelez : un esprit maléfique reste un esprit maléfique.
Que faites-vous ?
fr.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
Vous décidez de tenter le coup. La sortie de la cabane est tout près, vous pouvez y arriver.
Vous bondissez sur vos pieds et foncez vers la porte ouverte.
Bam, la porte se referme juste devant vous. Vous tirez sur la poignée, mais elle ne bouge pas.
— Ne fuis pas. Tu n’y arriveras pas de toute façon. Tu es sur mon territoire.
Vous vous tournez vers le fantôme. Et soudain, vous réalisez quelque chose.
fr.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
Vous restez figé, les yeux rivés sur le fantôme. Elle incline légèrement la tête et se penche vers vous.
— Tu as bien fait de ne pas fuir.
Sa voix résonne quelque part dans votre tête. Vous ne détournez pas le regard.
— Tu es sur mon territoire de toute façon.
Soudain, vous réalisez quelque chose.
fr.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
Mais vos mots traversent le fantôme sans l’atteindre. Vous voyez le givre tracer des veines depuis son corps vers vous. L’esprit de la femme rugit et se jette sur vous. En une seconde, sa main semi-transparente s’enfonce dans votre poitrine.
Vous vous attendez à ressentir une douleur, mais une seconde passe, puis une autre… et rien. Le fantôme recule et flotte de nouveau au-dessus du corps.
fr.68776bbe7609314123292533: Tu… ne peux pas me faire de mal.
fr.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Ha ! C’est tout ce que tu sais faire ?
fr.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
Le fantôme sourit, et une vague d’angoisse vous submerge. Pourquoi sourit-elle ? Son attaque n’a pas fonctionné ! Vous êtes vivant et…
Soudain, une douleur transperce votre poitrine. Vous chancellez. La douleur irradie jusque dans votre dos et votre bras. Le sourire du fantôme s’élargit.
— Et maintenant ? Ça te plaît ?
Vous entendez sa voix d’outre-tombe tandis que vous tombez à genoux. Respirer devient impossible. Vous comprenez à peine ce qui vient de se passer avant que votre conscience ne s’éteigne.
Tout comme votre vie.
fr.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Est-ce toi qui m’empêches de sortir des marais ?
fr.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
La jeune fille fantomatique hoche la tête.
— Tu ne quitteras pas cet endroit tant que je ne l’aurai pas décidé.
Et vous réalisez qu’elle ne ment pas. Mais pourquoi a-t-elle besoin de tout ça ?
fr.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Aide-moi, et je te laisserai partir,
— le fantôme vacille entre netteté et ondulation, comme la surface d’un lac troublée par une pierre.
Vous jetez malgré vous un regard au corps allongé sous elle.
fr.68776c901d977782c497b92d: Je ne vois pas comment je pourrais t’aider.
fr.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a:
— Je parle de moi ! Pas du corps.
— le fantôme se déforme un instant. Vous sursautez en voyant une lueur de rage sanguinaire passer sur son visage, mais une seconde plus tard, son expression redevient calme. Elle semble détester les questions inutiles. Mieux vaut s’en souvenir.

ge.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
ge.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
ge.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
ge.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
ge.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
ge.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
ge.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter!
ge.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
ge.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?
ge.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
ge.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
ge.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
ge.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Ha! Is that all you've got?
ge.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
ge.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
ge.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
ge.68776c7cc56cd8dae883c911: What do you want from me?
ge.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
ge.68776c901d977782c497b92d: It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything.
ge.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

hu.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.
hu.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
hu.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, frowning slightly. All your scratches hurt, so you move slower than planned. But it’s fine: surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
hu.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.
hu.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..
hu.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
You stop and look around. Surely you turned the wrong way somewhere. You need to go back and start over. You turn around and head away.
But you don’t see the outpost after half an hour, nor after an hour. Anxiety rises inside you. What the hell is going on?
hu.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Finally, you see a hut ahead and stop. Impassable swamps surround it. How could anyone survive here alone?
The house looks well-kept, but somehow… otherworldly.
hu.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
The house is cute and mysterious, but now is not the time to meddle in things that aren’t yours. You need to reach Targrad as soon as possible.
You pass the house and continue onward.
hu.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
You walk. And walk. And walk.
The road stretches ahead like a narrow ribbon, winding among swampy hummocks. You see a structure ahead and approach…
hu.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
…and realize that it is the same house. You even approached it from the same side as last time. Could you have gotten lost? But you remember walking on an absolutely straight road!
This is definitely some kinnd of magic. And its owner wants you to enter the house.
hu.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.
The first thing you notice is a body lying almost on the threshold. Then — herbs hanging from the ceiling. You realize some witch lives here. You lower your gaze to the body. Or, rather, lived here.
hu.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: To hell with it! Time to leave.
hu.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Better examine the house more carefully.
hu.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
hu.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
hu.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.

it.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finalmente raggiungi l'altra sponda del fiume. Ti volti indietro a guardare il guado. Nessuno ti sta salutando, ed è meglio così. L'ultima cosa che vorresti è rivedere i volti di quei banditi.
            Ancora non capisci come hai fatto a conoscere la password. Sicuramente è stato il Signore a benedirti con una conoscenza segreta. Questo significa che vuole che tu raggiunga Targrad. Significa che il tuo lavoro è importante. Questa consapevolezza ti spinge ad andare avanti.
it.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Davanti a te si estendono le paludi. Il sole si nasconde sempre più spesso dietro le nuvole. Cammini avanti, muovendo i piedi con leggerezza. Sicuramente tutte le difficoltà sono ormai alle tue spalle. Targrad non è più lontana.
it.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Davanti a te si estendono le paludi. Il sole si nasconde sempre più spesso dietro le nuvole. Cammini avanti, accigliandoti leggermente. Tutti i tuoi graffi ti fanno male, quindi ti muovi più lentamente del previsto. Ma va bene così: sicuramente tutte le difficoltà sono ormai alle tue spalle. Targrad non è più lontano.
it.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: Cammini e cammini. Le paludi intorno ti sembrano tutte uguali, al punto che smetti di sapere esattamente dove ti trovi. Passa mezz'ora. Passa un'ora. Guardi la mappa e ti rendi conto che avresti dovuto raggiungere la terraferma, ma le paludi non finiscono mai.
it.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: Sospiri e continui a camminare. Forse la mappa è imprecisa, forse hai perso la strada. Ma prima o poi arriverai da qualche parte se rimani sul sentiero. Giusto?..
it.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
Ti fermi e ti guardi intorno. Sicuramente hai sbagliato strada da qualche parte. Devi tornare indietro e ricominciare da capo. Ti volti e ti allontani.
            Ma dopo mezz'ora, e nemmeno dopo un'ora, non vedi l'avamposto. L'ansia cresce dentro di te. Che diavolo sta succedendo?
it.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Alla fine, vedi una capanna davanti a te e ti fermi. È circondata da paludi impraticabili. Come si può sopravvivere qui da soli?
            La casa sembra ben tenuta, ma in qualche modo... ultraterrena.
it.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
La casa è carina e misteriosa, ma ora non è il momento di immischiarsi in cose che non ti riguardano. Devi raggiungere Targrad il prima possibile.
            Superi la casa e prosegui.
it.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
Cammini. E cammini. E cammini.
            La strada si estende davanti a te come un nastro stretto, serpeggiando tra dossi paludosi. Vedi una struttura davanti a te e ti avvicini...
it.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
... e ti rendi conto che è la stessa casa. Ti sei persino avvicinato dallo stesso lato dell'ultima volta. Potresti esserti perso? Ma ricordi di aver camminato su una strada assolutamente diritta!
            Si tratta sicuramente di una sorta di magia. E il proprietario vuole che tu entri in casa.
it.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
La porta è leggermente aperta. La spingi ed entri.
            La prima cosa che noti è un corpo disteso quasi sulla soglia. Poi, delle erbe appese al soffitto. Ti rendi conto che qui vive una strega. Abbassi lo sguardo sul corpo. O, meglio, viveva qui.
it.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: Al diavolo! È ora di andarsene.
it.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Esamina meglio la casa con più attenzione.
it.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
Stai per andartene e continuare a vagare per le paludi alla ricerca di un'uscita, quando improvvisamente una forza ti tira indietro.
            "Aiutami..."
            Rabbrividisci e ti guardi intorno. Un sussurro, l'hai sentito chiaramente! Ma non c'è nessuno intorno, solo... Guardi il corpo. Ti viene la pelle d'oca. Sembra che qualcuno, o qualcosa, non voglia lasciarti andare facilmente. Non hai altra scelta.
it.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Esamina meglio la casa con più attenzione.
it.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
Ti sposti più avanti. La capanna è chiaramente pensata per una sola persona: trovi solo un letto e un servizio di piatti di legno. Tutto qui è pervaso da un'atmosfera magica e da un comfort inaspettatamente familiare. Nessun calderone strano con intrugli sospetti, nessun segno diabolico, nessun gatto nero o gallo. Se questa capanna non fosse costruita su palafitte in una palude, non la distingueresti da una normale casa di paese.
            Non trovi nulla di interessante.
it.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: Ti avvicini e ti fermi proprio sopra il cadavere. Una giovane donna giace a faccia in giù, con una spada conficcata nella schiena. Nessuno lascerebbe volontariamente la propria arma in un cadavere. Guardi la spada e ti rendi conto che è piuttosto costosa.
it.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: Ti avvicini e afferri l'elsa della spada. Improvvisamente, i tuoi palmi vengono bruciati da un freddo che non hai mai provato prima. Di riflesso, ritiri le mani.
it.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: Decidi di lasciare la spada al suo posto. Qualcosa dentro di te resiste all'idea di mutilare ulteriormente il corpo di una sconosciuta. Forse dovresti persino spostarla e seppellirla nel cortile.
it.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: Ma prima che tu possa chinarti, un fantasma si alza dal corpo proprio davanti a te. Indietreggi, senza sapere cosa fare.
it.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
Ignori l'avvertimento. Davanti a te si snoda il sentiero che porta a Targrad. Sicuramente i banditi dell'incrocio non sono gli unici ad aver approfittato della debolezza della città. Hai bisogno della spada più che del cadavere freddo.
            Afferri di nuovo l'elsa, stringendo i denti contro il freddo, ed estrai la spada. Scivola fuori dal corpo.
it.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
All'improvviso, un'onda di forza ti scaraventa indietro. Sbatti contro il muro e riprendi fiato. Davanti a te, il fantasma della donna assassinata si alza. La capanna diventa così fredda che inizi a tremare. O è paura?
            Il volto del fantasma è contorto dalla rabbia.
            — Come osi schernire il corpo di una vittima innocente?!
it.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: Il fantasma ride. La sua risata riecheggia nella capanna, facendoti venire i brividi lungo la schiena. Cosa fai?
it.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
Il fantasma non risponde, sorride soltanto. Non vedi un cadavere, ma una giovane donna. Ma non farti ingannare, ti ricordi, uno spirito maligno rimane uno spirito maligno.
            Cosa fai?
it.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
Decidi di correre il rischio. L'uscita della capanna è molto vicina, ce la puoi fare.
            Ti alzi di scatto e corri verso la porta aperta.
            Bang: la porta si chiude proprio davanti a te. Tiri la maniglia, ma non si muove.
            - Non scappare. Non ci riuscirai comunque. Sei nel mio territorio.
            Ti giri verso il fantasma. All'improvviso, capisci qualcosa.
it.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
Ti blocchi sul posto, fissando il fantasma. Lei inclina leggermente la testa e si avvicina a te.
            — Hai fatto bene a non scappare.
            La sua voce riecheggia nella tua testa. Non distogli lo sguardo.
            — Sei comunque nel mio territorio.
            All'improvviso, ti rendi conto di qualcosa.
it.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
Ma le tue parole non vengono ascoltate dal fantasma. Vedi il gelo tracciare dei percorsi dal suo corpo verso di te. Il fantasma della donna ruggisce e ti si avventa contro. In un secondo, la sua mano semitrasparente ti affonda nel petto.
            Ti aspetti di provare dolore, ma passa un secondo, poi un altro... e non succede nulla. Il fantasma indietreggia e torna a librarsi sopra il corpo.
it.68776bbe7609314123292533: Tu... non puoi farmi del male.
it.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Ah! È tutto quello che sai fare?
it.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
Il fantasma sorride e un'ondata di ansia ti travolge. Perché sta sorridendo? Il suo attacco non ha funzionato! Sei vivo e...
            All'improvviso, un dolore lancinante ti trafigge il petto. Barcolli. Il dolore si irradia alla schiena e al braccio. Il sorriso del fantasma si allarga.
            — E adesso? Ti piace?
Senti la sua voce ultraterrena mentre cadi in ginocchio. Respirare è ormai impossibile. Riesci a malapena a capire cosa è successo prima che la coscienza ti abbandoni.
            Così come la tua vita.
it.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: È colpa tua se non riesco a uscire dalle paludi?
it.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
La ragazza spettrale annuisce.
            — Non te ne andrai da qui finché non te lo permetterò.
            E ti rendi conto che non sta mentendo. Ma perché ha bisogno di tutto questo?
it.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Aiutami e ti lascerò andare — il fantasma oscilla tra la chiarezza e un'increspatura, come un lago disturbato da un sasso lanciato.
            Involontariamente guardi il corpo che giace sotto di lei.
it.68776c901d977782c497b92d: Non sembra che io possa aiutarti in alcun modo.
it.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — Intendo me stessa! Non il corpo. — Il fantasma si sposta per un attimo. Sussulti quando un ghigno assetato di sangue le attraversa il volto, ma un secondo dopo la sua espressione è di nuovo calma. Sembra che non le piacciano le domande inutili. Meglio ricordarlo.

jp.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
jp.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
jp.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
jp.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
jp.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
jp.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
jp.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
jp.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
jp.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
jp.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter!
jp.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
jp.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?
jp.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
jp.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
jp.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
jp.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Ha! Is that all you've got?
jp.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
jp.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
jp.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
jp.68776c7cc56cd8dae883c911: What do you want from me?
jp.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
jp.68776c901d977782c497b92d: It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything.
jp.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

kr.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.
kr.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.

kr.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.
kr.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..
kr.68776882bbe160d53138531b:

kr.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:

What do you do?
po.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
po.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
po.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
po.68776bc162c7905ee6b0cfe5: Ha! Is that all you've got?
po.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
po.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
po.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
po.68776c7cc56cd8dae883c911: What do you want from me?
po.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
po.68776c901d977782c497b92d: It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything.
po.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

sk.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.
sk.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
sk.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, frowning slightly. All your scratches hurt, so you move slower than planned. But it’s fine: surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
sk.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.
sk.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..
sk.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
You stop and look around. Surely you turned the wrong way somewhere. You need to go back and start over. You turn around and head away.
But you don’t see the outpost after half an hour, nor after an hour. Anxiety rises inside you. What the hell is going on?
sk.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Finally, you see a hut ahead and stop. Impassable swamps surround it. How could anyone survive here alone?
The house looks well-kept, but somehow… otherworldly.
sk.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
The house is cute and mysterious, but now is not the time to meddle in things that aren’t yours. You need to reach Targrad as soon as possible.
You pass the house and continue onward.
sk.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
You walk. And walk. And walk.
The road stretches ahead like a narrow ribbon, winding among swampy hummocks. You see a structure ahead and approach…
sk.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
…and realize that it is the same house. You even approached it from the same side as last time. Could you have gotten lost? But you remember walking on an absolutely straight road!
This is definitely some kinnd of magic. And its owner wants you to enter the house.
sk.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.
The first thing you notice is a body lying almost on the threshold. Then — herbs hanging from the ceiling. You realize some witch lives here. You lower your gaze to the body. Or, rather, lived here.
sk.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: To hell with it! Time to leave.
sk.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Better examine the house more carefully.
sk.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
sk.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
sk.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
sk.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
sk.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
sk.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
sk.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
sk.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
sk.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
sk.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
sk.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter!
sk.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
