hu.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:
You don’t understand why they care about the book. There’s nothing strange about it. Or is there?..  
— We’re required to check everything, — one of the guards says, unbuckling the straps on the book and opening it. A pause hangs in the air. You see his eyes darting, his expression shifting. He flips through a few pages, mutters a curse under his breath, and slams the book shut.
— What heresy! Utter nonsense. To think someone came up with this...
He stuffs the book back into your travel bag.  
— You learned folk have nothing better to do than conjure up such gibberish.
hu.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: You decide not to react, though your mind races. What did the guard read in there? You haven’t opened the book since you took it.
hu.688cde5f16c9774461027a6c: Read it when you get the chance.
hu.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
The guard’s reaction to the text unsettles you. Maybe you shouldn’t have taken it? Probably not. How did the book end up in that basement, and why hadn’t anyone claimed it before you? Each question makes you more uneasy. It’s best to get rid of the book—but only after you’ve finished your business here.
You say nothing more, letting the guards lead you onward.
hu.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: You’ll read the book on your way back. For now, you just need to complete your task. Eager to get to the book, you stay silent, letting the guards lead you further.

hu.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. To his left, a young man, bored, propping his head on his hand. None of them seem pleased to be bothered. The other three lords are either absent or couldn’t be bothered to show.
hu.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
hu.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
hu.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
hu.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— So we’ll make one! — the youth looks at you with mockery and defiance. The man in the middle raises his hand.
— Enough! It doesn’t matter now. Stop bickering like little children.
hu.688ce0cbe03f37a53d2fd2d2:

For now.

hu.688ce11f41c2999201789185: It’s about a prophecy from the Order of Navigators.
hu.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:
— A prophecy? What nonsense! — the woman laughs hoarsely, covering her mouth with her hand. You stand still, waiting it out. They can laugh all they want, but every prophecy of the Order of Navigators’ leader has always come true. Targrad will have to accept it.
— Targrad is no place for such superstitious nonsense, — the young man chimes in, looking at you with mockery, — we deal in science here.
hu.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: You don't understand! Every prophecy has always come true!
hu.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: You can simply hear the prophecy without believing it.
hu.688ce15c6bbcad99f9904c4d: You let your emotions surge. How dare they question the will of the Order’s leader?! The previous ruler took prophecies seriously. But these... they understand nothing. Your task is to set them on the true path.
hu.688ce160b2181bac5a8abd2e: You strive to stay calm and composed. They may not believe in prophecies, but they must hear it. It's your duty. Without this, you might as well not return to the Order.
hu.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:

hu.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
The youth wants to say something, but the man in the central chair raises his hand, stopping him.

You nod. The man beckons you closer. A faint glimmer of interest flickers in his eyes. Well, looks like you've managed to pique his curiosity.
— Hand me the scroll. I’ll read it.
hu.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
You yank the scroll out with a sharp motion. The figures on the thrones flinch. Even the youth sits up straight, leaning forward with a face twisted in anger. It seems no one has defied him in a long time. The guards’ footsteps behind you quicken.
You break the seal on the scroll and...
hu.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
You calmly pull the scroll from your bag. For a moment, it seems to glow, but you blink, and the effect vanishes. Strange, perhaps you're just that exhausted?
— Come on, don't dawdle, — the woman says, her lips curling in annoyance as she notices your hesitation. — We have other matters to attend to besides your prophecy.
The way she spits out the last word makes it clear she doesn’t believe in it either. Well, that’s their problem. And this city’s.
You step closer and hand the scroll to the man in the center.
hu.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...everything is flooded with blue light. You feel the magic emanating from the scroll with your entire being. It seeps into you, pierces through you, destroys you. But you feel no pain. You cease to exist, detachedly thinking:
"Looks like I've become death itself, indeed."
hu.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
You watch as the man breaks the seal of your order, prying open the edge of the scroll with his fingers. For a moment, you see blue sparks again, you frown and shake your head. It seems you desperately need some sleep.
The sparks grow brighter, you blink, and...

it.688cdcf0a2b55c50cdc5c008: — Bene, siamo arrivati. I signori ti stanno già aspettando — dice una delle guardie, la stessa che ti ha parlato prima, lasciandoti andare e indicando le alte porte.
it.688cdcfa2e2dae6bd4636ed5: Signori? Ce n'è più di uno?
it.688cdd07085555ce8608795e:
— Sì, sei. Tutto qui, non ci sono altre domande. Vai avanti prima che ti trasciniamo dentro con la forza.
            Ti danno una spinta alla schiena.
it.688cdd0bf4ac4129d31d580b: Decidi che per ora è meglio tenere la bocca chiusa. È più sicuro così.
it.688cdd25652c3fa4d4fb080f:
Vieni condotto all'interno del palazzo. L'atmosfera è opprimente. Ci sono pochi servitori, che si muovono quasi in punta di piedi.
            Vieni fermato davanti a grandi porte di legno alte tre volte la tua statura. Le guardie ti ordinano di allargare le braccia e di lasciarti perquisire.
it.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
Ti perquisiscono i fianchi, le braccia e le cosce, rovistando nella tua borsa da viaggio.
            — Che cos'è questo? — Una delle guardie trova il libro che hai preso dalle rovine.
it.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: Ti perquisiscono i fianchi, le braccia e le cosce, rovistando nella tua borsa da viaggio, ma non trovano nulla di interessante. Con espressioni acide, ti restituiscono la borsa senza commentare ciò che è appena successo.
it.688cdda671d261ee2411751f: Da quando i libri sono proibiti?
it.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:
Non capisci perché siano così interessati al libro. Non c'è nulla di strano in esso. O forse sì...?
            — Siamo tenuti a controllare tutto, — dice una delle guardie, slacciando le cinghie che fissano il libro e aprendolo. C'è una pausa sospesa nell'aria. Vedi i suoi occhi che si muovono rapidamente, la sua espressione che cambia. Sfoglia alcune pagine, mormora una maledizione sottovoce e chiude il libro con uno sbattere.
— Che eresia! Assolutamente senza senso. Pensare che qualcuno abbia potuto inventarsi una cosa del genere...
            Rimette il libro nella tua borsa da viaggio.
            — Voi studiosi non avete niente di meglio da fare che inventarvi queste sciocchezze.
it.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: Decidi di non reagire, anche se la tua mente corre. Cosa ha letto la guardia lì dentro? Non hai aperto il libro da quando l'hai preso.
it.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
La reazione della guardia al testo ti turba. Forse non avresti dovuto prenderlo? Probabilmente no. Come è finito quel libro in quel seminterrato e perché nessuno lo aveva reclamato prima di te? Ogni domanda ti rende più inquieto. È meglio sbarazzarsi del libro, ma solo dopo aver finito quello che devi fare qui.
            Non dici altro e lasci che le guardie ti conducano avanti.
it.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: Leggerai il libro al ritorno. Per ora, devi solo portare a termine il tuo compito. Ansioso di leggere il libro, rimani in silenzio e lasci che le guardie ti conducano oltre.
it.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c: Vieni condotto nella sala del trono. Cerchi di non guardare con stupore ciò che ti circonda, ma è difficile. La sala è sfarzosa, ma trascurata. Ragnatele ricoprono gli angoli e una macchia sul pavimento, vino o sangue, non è stata completamente rimossa. In fondo alla sala ci sono sei sedie, solo tre delle quali sono occupate. Sembrano essere state sistemate lì da poco.
it.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
Le guardie ti avvicinano, poi si fermano. Si inchinano e si fanno da parte. Nessuno ti tiene, ma sai che una mossa sbagliata ti costerà la vita senza esitazione.
Osservi i tre davanti a te. Un uomo corpulento, sulla quarantina, è seduto al centro, con le gambe divaricate. Alla sua destra, una donna magra, con le labbra serrate così forte che il mento le trema. Alla sua sinistra, un giovane annoiato, con la testa appoggiata sulla mano. Nessuno di loro sembra contento di essere disturbato. Gli altri tre signori sono assenti o non si sono degnati di presentarsi.
it.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
L'uomo al centro ti osserva attentamente.
            — Allora, cosa dovresti fare nella nostra città?
            "Nostra". Sorrisi. Sei venuto nella città del re, non nella loro. Come cambiano rapidamente le cose! Ma non importa. Hai un obiettivo e devi perseguirlo.
it.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
L'uomo al centro parla per primo.
            — Quindi è lui che sta cercando di riempire la testa della plebaglia con le sue idee?
            Il disprezzo nella sua voce ti fa innervosire. Sai bene che, se avessi avuto più tempo, la gente in piazza ti avrebbe ascoltato. Ma sei stato catturato e trascinato qui.
— Che arroganza — dice la donna con un sorriso, gli occhi freddi come il ghiaccio.
            — Non ne abbiamo bisogno a Targrad. Gli avrei tagliato la gola piuttosto che trascinarlo qui — mormora il giovane, troppo assorto nelle sue unghie per degnarti di uno sguardo.
it.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: Non esiste alcuna legge che vieti di parlare alla gente.
it.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— Allora ne faremo uno! — Il giovane ti guarda con scherno e sfida. L'uomo al centro alza la mano.
            — Basta! Ora non ha più importanza. Smettetela di litigare come bambini piccoli.

it.688ce10116403e2bd3b1d6fd: Ho qualcosa che posso condividere solo con il sovrano locale.
it.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:
Tutti e tre seduti sulle sedie si scambiano sguardi. Li vedi aggrottare le sopracciglia, lanciandosi sguardi sprezzanti l'uno all'altro. Ti rendi conto che ognuno di loro vorrebbe governare da solo. Ma questo è impossibile.
            Per ora.
            L'uomo al centro prende la parola.
            — Allora, di cosa si tratta? Qui siamo tutti uguali, quindi puoi parlare liberamente.
it.688ce11f41c2999201789185: Si tratta di una profezia dell'Ordine dei Navigatori.
it.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:
— Una profezia? Che sciocchezza! — La donna ride con voce roca, coprendosi la bocca con la mano. Tu rimani immobile, aspettando che finisca. Possono ridere quanto vogliono, ma ogni profezia del leader dell'Ordine dei Navigatori si è sempre avverata. Targrad dovrà accettarlo.
            — Targrad non è un posto per queste sciocchezze superstiziose, — interviene il giovane, guardandoti con tono beffardo, — qui ci occupiamo di scienza.
it.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: Tu non capisci! Tutte le profezie si sono sempre avverate!
it.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: Puoi semplicemente ascoltare la profezia senza crederci.
it.688ce15c6bbcad99f9904c4d: Lasci che le tue emozioni prendano il sopravvento. Come osano mettere in discussione la volontà del leader dell'Ordine?! Il precedente sovrano prendeva sul serio le profezie. Ma questi... non capiscono nulla. Il tuo compito è quello di indirizzarli sulla retta via.
it.688ce160b2181bac5a8abd2e: Cerca di mantenere la calma e la compostezza. Forse non credono alle profezie, ma devono ascoltarla. È tuo dovere. Senza questo, tanto vale non tornare all'Ordine.
it.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:
— Sì, sì, non capiamo niente — il giovane sul trono alza gli occhi al cielo e fa cenno alle guardie. — Portatelo via da qui. Lasciate che legga le sue profezie agli ubriachi nella taverna.
            Senti le guardie avvicinarsi. Hai solo pochi istanti per fare ciò per cui sei venuto.
it.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
Il giovane vuole dire qualcosa, ma l'uomo seduto sulla sedia centrale alza la mano, fermandolo.
            — È tutto ciò di cui hai bisogno? Che leggiamo la profezia del tuo ordine? Come si chiamano... I Navigatori?
            Tu annuisci. L'uomo ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. Un debole barlume di interesse balena nei suoi occhi. Beh, sembra che tu sia riuscito a stuzzicare la sua curiosità.
— Passami la pergamena. Lo leggerò.
it.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
Strappi la pergamena con un movimento brusco. Le figure sui troni sussultano. Anche il giovane si mette seduto dritto, sporgendosi in avanti con il volto contorto dalla rabbia. Sembra che nessuno gli abbia tenuto testa da molto tempo. I passi delle guardie dietro di te si fanno più rapidi.
            Rompi il sigillo sulla pergamena e...
it.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
Tiri fuori con calma la pergamena dalla borsa. Per un attimo sembra brillare, ma sbatti le palpebre e l'effetto svanisce. Strano, forse sei solo esausto?
            — Dai, non perdere tempo — dice la donna, con le labbra incurvate in un'espressione di fastidio quando nota la tua esitazione. — Abbiamo altre cose da fare oltre alla tua profezia.
Il modo in cui sputa fuori l'ultima parola rende chiaro che nemmeno lei ci crede. Beh, è un problema loro. E di questa città.
            Ti avvicini e consegni la pergamena all'uomo al centro.
it.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...tutto è inondato da una luce blu. Senti la magia emanata dalla pergamena con tutto il tuo essere. Ti penetra, ti trafigge, ti distrugge. Ma non provi dolore. Cessi di esistere, pensando distaccatamente:
            "Sembra che io sia diventato la morte stessa, davvero".
it.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
Guardi l'uomo che rompe il sigillo del tuo ordine, aprendo il bordo della pergamena con le dita. Per un attimo, vedi di nuovo delle scintille blu, aggrotta le sopracciglia e scuoti la testa. Sembra che tu abbia un disperato bisogno di dormire.
            Le scintille diventano più luminose, sbatti le palpebre e...
it.689f6b7ef5087b91c8cb7657: Sei arrivato dritto al cuore della questione. I segreti saranno svelati un po' più tardi. Per ora sii paziente e torna di nuovo.

kr.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag.
— What’s this we’ve got here? — one of the guards finds the book you took from the ruins.
kr.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag but find nothing of interest. With sour expressions, they return your bag without commenting on what just happened.
kr.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:

— What heresy! Utter nonsense. To think someone came up with this...

— You learned folk have nothing better to do than conjure up such gibberish.

kr.688cde5f16c9774461027a6c: Read it when you get the chance.
kr.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:

Each question makes you more uneasy. It’s best to get rid of the book—but only after you’ve finished your business here.
You say nothing more, letting the guards lead you onward.
kr.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: You’ll read the book on your way back. For now, you just need to complete your task. Eager to get to the book, you stay silent, letting the guards lead you further.

kr.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. kr.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
kr.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
kr.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
kr.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:

sk.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. To his left, a young man, bored, propping his head on his hand. None of them seem pleased to be bothered. The other three lords are either absent or couldn’t be bothered to show.
sk.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
sk.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
sk.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
sk.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— So we’ll make one! — the youth looks at you with mockery and defiance. The man in the middle raises his hand.
— Enough! It doesn’t matter now. Stop bickering like little children.
sk.688ce0cbe03f37a53d2fd2d2:

sk.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:

For now.

sk.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:

sk.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: You don't understand! Every prophecy has always come true!
sk.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: You can simply hear the prophecy without believing it.

sk.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:

sk.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:

You step closer and hand the scroll to the man in the center.

tu.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:

ru.688cdd0bf4ac4129d31d580b: Ты решаешь, что лучше сейчас не открывать рот лишний раз. Целее будешь.
ru.688cdd25652c3fa4d4fb080f:
Тебя проводят внутрь дворца. Атмосфера здесь гнетущая. Слуг мало и все они ходят едва ли не на цыпочках.
Тебя останавливают перед роскошными деревянными дверьми в три твоих роста. Стражники заставляют тебя раскинуть руки и дать себя обыскать.
ru.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
Они прохлопывают тебя по бокам, рукам и бёдрам, роются в походной сумке. 
— А это что у нас тут? — один из стражников находит книгу, которую ты забрал из руин.
ru.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: Они прохлопывают тебя по бокам, рукам и бёдрам, роются в походной сумке, но ничего интересного не находят.  С кислым видом тебе возвращают сумку и никак не комментируют что только что произошло.

ru.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:

— Мы обязаны проверить всё, — один из стражников щёлкает ремешками на книге и открывает её. Повисает пауза. Ты видишь, как бегают глаза стражника, как меняется выражение его лица. Он пролистывает несколько страниц, ругается себе под нос и захлопывает книгу.
— Какая же ересь! Полный бред. Надо же было такое придумать...
Он запихивает книгу обратно в твой походный мешок.
— Совсем вам, учёным людям, делать нечего, раз такую околесицу придумываете.
ru.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: Ты решаешь не реагировать на это, хотя голова полна мыслей. Что же там такое вычитал стражник? Ты не открывал книгу с того самого момента, как получил её.
ru.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:

От каждого вопроса тебе становится не по себе. Лучше от книги избавиться, но после того, как ты закончишь своё дело.

ru.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: Ты сможешь прочитать книгу на обратном пути. Осталось только закончить со своей задачей. Тебе не терпится поскорее добраться до книги, так что ты больше ничего не говоришь, позволяя страже вести тебя дальше.
ru.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c:
Тебя заводят в тронный зал. Ты стараешься не вертеть головой, рассматривая всё вокруг, но не получается. Зал роскошен, но как будто за ним не успевают следить. Кое-где висит паутина, на полу не до конца затёрто какое-то пятно. То ли вино, то ли кровь.
На дальнем конце зала стоят шесть кресел, три из них заняты. Кажется, их сюда поставили совсем недавно.
ru.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
Тебя подводят к креслам ближе, а потом останавливают. Стража кланяется и расходится чуть в стороны. Тебя никто не держит, но ты понимаешь: одно неверное движение и тебя зарубят без тени сомнений.
Ты смотришь на тех, кто восседает перед тобой. Дородный мужчина лет сорока сидит посередине, широко расставив ноги. Справа от него сухая женщина. Её губы сжаты так сильно, что подбородок дрожит. Слева от мужчины сидит парень со скучающим видом, подперев голову рукой. Все они явно не рады, что их отвлекают. Остальные трое, видимо, не смогли подойти. Или просто не захотели.
ru.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:

— Так что ты должен сделать в нашем городе?
"Нашем". Ты усмехаешься. Ты шёл в город короля, а не в "их" город. Как быстро всё может поменяться! Но какая разница? У тебя есть цель и ты должен её придерживаться.
ru.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:

Ты вскидываешься от пренебрежения, которым сочатся эти слова. Ты знаешь, что, дай тебе побольше времени, люди на площади прислушались бы. Но тебя схватили и притащили сюда.
— Надо же, какая самоуверенность, — женщина улыбается, но глаза её остаются холодны.
— Нам в Тарграде такого не надо. Я б сразу прирезал, а не сюда тащил, — скучающий юнец даже не смотрит на тебя, слишком занятый собственными ногтями.
ru.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:

— Хватит! Это не имеет значения сейчас. Перестаньте пререкаться как дети малые.

ru.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
Юнец что-то хочет сказать, но мужчина на центральном кресле поднимает руку и останавливает его.
— Это всё, что тебе требуется? Просто, чтобы мы прочитали пророчество от твоего ордена? Как его там... Кормчих?
Ты киваешь. Мужчина жестом подзывает тебя к себе. В его глазах заметен лёгкий блеск интереса. Что ж, тебе удалось заинтересовать его.
— Давай сюда свиток. Я прочту.
ru.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
Ты вытаскиваешь свиток резким движением. Сидящие на тронах вздрагивают. Даже юнец садится нормально, подаётся вперед с перекошенным от гнева лицом. Кажется, ему никто давно не перечил. Шаги стражи за твоей спиной ускоряются.
Ты ломаешь печать на свитке и...
ru.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
Ты спокойно достаёшь свиток из сумки. На секунду тебе кажется, будто он светится, но ты моргаешь, и это пропадает. Странно, может быть ты настолько устал?
— Ну же, не тяните, — женщина, видя твоё замешательство, недовольно кривит губы, — у нас есть и другие дела, помимо вашего пророчества.
По тому, как она буквально выплёвывает последнее слово ты понимаешь, что она тоже в него не верит. Что ж, это уже их проблемы. И этого города. 
Ты подходишь ближе и протягиваешь свиток мужчине посередине.
ru.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...всё затапливает синий свет. Ты чувствуешь магию, исходящую от свитка, всей своей сущностью. Она проникает в тебя, проходит насквозь, разрушает. Но ты не чувствуешь боли. Ты прекращаешь существовать, отстранённо думая:
"А ведь я и правда стал смертью".
ru.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
Ты смотришь, как мужчина разламывает печать твоего ордена, как подцепляет край свитка пальцами. На секунду тебе снова мерещатся синие искры, ты хмуришься и трясёшь головой. Кажется, тебе очень нужно поспать.
Искр становится больше, ты моргаешь и...

ro.688cdcf0a2b55c50cdc5c008: — Well, we’re here. The lords are already waiting for you, — one of the guards, the same one who spoke to you earlier, lets go of you and waves toward the tall doors.
ro.688cdd07085555ce8608795e:
— Yup, six of them. That’s it, no more questions. Go on before we drag you in by force.
You’re nudged in the back.
ro.688cdd0bf4ac4129d31d580b: You decide it’s better to keep your mouth shut for now. Safer that way.
ro.688cdd25652c3fa4d4fb080f:
You’re led inside the palace. The atmosphere is oppressive. There are few servants, and they move almost on tiptoes.
You’re stopped before grand wooden doors three times your height. The guards order you to spread your arms and let them search you.
ro.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag.
— What’s this we’ve got here? — one of the guards finds the book you took from the ruins.
ro.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag but find nothing of interest. With sour expressions, they return your bag without commenting on what just happened.
ro.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:
You don’t understand why they care about the book. There’s nothing strange about it. Or is there?..  
— We’re required to check everything, — one of the guards says, unbuckling the straps on the book and opening it. A pause hangs in the air. You see his eyes darting, his expression shifting. He flips through a few pages, mutters a curse under his breath, and slams the book shut.
— What heresy! Utter nonsense. To think someone came up with this...
He stuffs the book back into your travel bag.  
— You learned folk have nothing better to do than conjure up such gibberish.
ro.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: You decide not to react, though your mind races. What did the guard read in there? You haven’t opened the book since you took it.
ro.688cde5f16c9774461027a6c: Read it when you get the chance.
ro.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
The guard’s reaction to the text unsettles you. Maybe you shouldn’t have taken it? Probably not. How did the book end up in that basement, and why hadn’t anyone claimed it before you? Each question makes you more uneasy. It’s best to get rid of the book—but only after you’ve finished your business here.
You say nothing more, letting the guards lead you onward.
ro.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: You’ll read the book on your way back. For now, you just need to complete your task. Eager to get to the book, you stay silent, letting the guards lead you further.
ro.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c: You’re brought into the throne room. You try not to gawk at your surroundings, but it’s hard. The hall is lavish, yet neglected. Cobwebs cling to corners, and a stain on the floor, wine or blood, hasn’t been fully scrubbed out. At the far end, six chairs stand, only three occupied. They look recently placed.
ro.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. To his left, a young man, bored, propping his head on his hand. None of them seem pleased to be bothered. The other three lords are either absent or couldn’t be bothered to show.
ro.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
ro.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
ro.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
ro.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— So we’ll make one! — the youth looks at you with mockery and defiance. The man in the middle raises his hand.
— Enough! It doesn’t matter now. Stop bickering like little children.
ro.688ce0cbe03f37a53d2fd2d2:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
ro.688ce0fef027489c75abab7d: I must deliver a prophecy to you from the Order of Navigators.
ro.688ce10116403e2bd3b1d6fd: I have something I can only share with the local ruler.
ro.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:
All three seated in the chairs exchange glances. You see them frown, casting contemptuous looks at one another. You realize each would relish ruling alone. But that’s impossible.
For now.
The man in the middle speaks up.
— So, what’s this about? We’re all equals here, so you can speak freely.
ro.688ce11f41c2999201789185: It’s about a prophecy from the Order of Navigators.
ro.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:
— A prophecy? What nonsense! — the woman laughs hoarsely, covering her mouth with her hand. You stand still, waiting it out. They can laugh all they want, but every prophecy of the Order of Navigators’ leader has always come true. Targrad will have to accept it.
— Targrad is no place for such superstitious nonsense, — the young man chimes in, looking at you with mockery, — we deal in science here.
ro.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: You don't understand! Every prophecy has always come true!
ro.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: You can simply hear the prophecy without believing it.
ro.688ce15c6bbcad99f9904c4d: You let your emotions surge. How dare they question the will of the Order’s leader?! The previous ruler took prophecies seriously. But these... they understand nothing. Your task is to set them on the true path.
ro.688ce160b2181bac5a8abd2e: You strive to stay calm and composed. They may not believe in prophecies, but they must hear it. It's your duty. Without this, you might as well not return to the Order.
ro.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:
— Yeah, yeah, we don’t understand a thing, — the youth on the throne rolls his eyes and gestures to the guards. — Take him out of here. Let him read his prophecies to the drunks in the tavern.
You hear the guards approaching. You have mere moments to do what you came for.
ro.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
The youth wants to say something, but the man in the central chair raises his hand, stopping him.
— Is that all you need? For us to read the prophecy from your order? What are they called again... The Navigators?
You nod. The man beckons you closer. A faint glimmer of interest flickers in his eyes. Well, looks like you've managed to pique his curiosity.
— Hand me the scroll. I’ll read it.
ro.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
You yank the scroll out with a sharp motion. The figures on the thrones flinch. Even the youth sits up straight, leaning forward with a face twisted in anger. It seems no one has defied him in a long time. The guards’ footsteps behind you quicken.
You break the seal on the scroll and...
ro.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
You calmly pull the scroll from your bag. For a moment, it seems to glow, but you blink, and the effect vanishes. Strange, perhaps you're just that exhausted?
— Come on, don't dawdle, — the woman says, her lips curling in annoyance as she notices your hesitation. — We have other matters to attend to besides your prophecy.
The way she spits out the last word makes it clear she doesn’t believe in it either. Well, that’s their problem. And this city’s.
You step closer and hand the scroll to the man in the center.
ro.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...everything is flooded with blue light. You feel the magic emanating from the scroll with your entire being. It seeps into you, pierces through you, destroys you. But you feel no pain. You cease to exist, detachedly thinking:
"Looks like I've become death itself, indeed."
ro.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
You watch as the man breaks the seal of your order, prying open the edge of the scroll with his fingers. For a moment, you see blue sparks again, you frown and shake your head. It seems you desperately need some sleep.
The sparks grow brighter, you blink, and...
ro.689f6b7ef5087b91c8cb7657: You’ve gotten right up to the heart of it. The secrets will be revealed a little later. Be patient for now and come back again.

— Yeah, yeah, we don’t understand a thing, — the youth on the throne rolls his eyes and gestures to the guards. — Take him out of here. Let him read his prophecies to the drunks in the tavern.
You hear the guards approaching. You have mere moments to do what you came for.
in.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
The youth wants to say something, but the man in the central chair raises his hand, stopping him.
— Is that all you need? For us to read the prophecy from your order? What are they called again... The Navigators?
You nod. The man beckons you closer. A faint glimmer of interest flickers in his eyes. Well, looks like you've managed to pique his curiosity.
— Hand me the scroll. I’ll read it.
in.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
You yank the scroll out with a sharp motion. The figures on the thrones flinch. Even the youth sits up straight, leaning forward with a face twisted in anger. It seems no one has defied him in a long time. The guards’ footsteps behind you quicken.
You break the seal on the scroll and...
in.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
You calmly pull the scroll from your bag. For a moment, it seems to glow, but you blink, and the effect vanishes. Strange, perhaps you're just that exhausted?
— Come on, don't dawdle, — the woman says, her lips curling in annoyance as she notices your hesitation. — We have other matters to attend to besides your prophecy.
The way she spits out the last word makes it clear she doesn’t believe in it either. Well, that’s their problem. And this city’s.
You step closer and hand the scroll to the man in the center.
in.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...everything is flooded with blue light. You feel the magic emanating from the scroll with your entire being. It seeps into you, pierces through you, destroys you. But you feel no pain. You cease to exist, detachedly thinking:
"Looks like I've become death itself, indeed."
in.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
You watch as the man breaks the seal of your order, prying open the edge of the scroll with his fingers. For a moment, you see blue sparks again, you frown and shake your head. It seems you desperately need some sleep.
The sparks grow brighter, you blink, and...

th.688cdcf0a2b55c50cdc5c008: — Well, we’re here. The lords are already waiting for you, — one of the guards, the same one who spoke to you earlier, lets go of you and waves toward the tall doors.
th.688cdd07085555ce8608795e:
— Yup, six of them. That’s it, no more questions. Go on before we drag you in by force.
You’re nudged in the back.
th.688cdd0bf4ac4129d31d580b: You decide it’s better to keep your mouth shut for now. Safer that way.
th.688cdd25652c3fa4d4fb080f:
You’re led inside the palace. The atmosphere is oppressive. There are few servants, and they move almost on tiptoes.
You’re stopped before grand wooden doors three times your height. The guards order you to spread your arms and let them search you.
th.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag.
— What’s this we’ve got here? — one of the guards finds the book you took from the ruins.
th.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag but find nothing of interest. With sour expressions, they return your bag without commenting on what just happened.
th.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:
You don’t understand why they care about the book. There’s nothing strange about it. Or is there?..  
— We’re required to check everything, — one of the guards says, unbuckling the straps on the book and opening it. A pause hangs in the air. You see his eyes darting, his expression shifting. He flips through a few pages, mutters a curse under his breath, and slams the book shut.
— What heresy! Utter nonsense. To think someone came up with this...
He stuffs the book back into your travel bag.  
— You learned folk have nothing better to do than conjure up such gibberish.
th.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: You decide not to react, though your mind races. What did the guard read in there? You haven’t opened the book since you took it.
th.688cde5f16c9774461027a6c: Read it when you get the chance.
th.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
The guard’s reaction to the text unsettles you. Maybe you shouldn’t have taken it? Probably not. How did the book end up in that basement, and why hadn’t anyone claimed it before you? Each question makes you more uneasy. It’s best to get rid of the book—but only after you’ve finished your business here.
You say nothing more, letting the guards lead you onward.
th.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: You’ll read the book on your way back. For now, you just need to complete your task. Eager to get to the book, you stay silent, letting the guards lead you further.
th.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c: You’re brought into the throne room. You try not to gawk at your surroundings, but it’s hard. The hall is lavish, yet neglected. Cobwebs cling to corners, and a stain on the floor, wine or blood, hasn’t been fully scrubbed out. At the far end, six chairs stand, only three occupied. They look recently placed.
th.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. To his left, a young man, bored, propping his head on his hand. None of them seem pleased to be bothered. The other three lords are either absent or couldn’t be bothered to show.
th.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
th.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
th.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
th.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— So we’ll make one! — the youth looks at you with mockery and defiance. The man in the middle raises his hand.
— Enough! It doesn’t matter now. Stop bickering like little children.

ru.6863b2e18ee2bded10238737:
Рискну предположить, что для многих Thunder Lotus как разработчик ассоциируется в первую очередь со Spiritfarer, довольно милой и уютной — насколько в данном случае вообще возможно применение подобного эпитета — игрой о смерти. Однако до путешествия Стеллы по загробному миру разработчики из Монреаля выпустили Jotun и Sundered, и именно о последнем мне бы хотелось немного поговорить.

С точки зрения игрового процесса, Sundered можно охарактеризовать как реиграбельную метроидванию: вы исследуете постоянно меняющиеся подземелья, сражаетесь с ордами жутких существ и выбираете между человечностью и безумием.
ru.686bdc49eb7e70deaa5be000:
Краткое описание мира
Позднее Средневековье. Только человеческая раса. В мире есть магия. Обычным людям она недоступна, ей пользуются только немногочисленные святые ордена и ведьмы/колдуны, скрывающиеся в труднодоступных местах.
Время в игре
Ранняя осень.
Стиль построек и окружения 
Деревня, сельская местность, леса – русский север/финские территории, основной референс – Карелия. Город более европейский, референс – Выборг.
ru.686bdc4be992c4f7c98f2e81:
Мироустройство и основные сущности
Город Тар сохраняет некоторую автономию от столицы. Территория рядом с городом недавно стала полем боя двух противоборствующих семей: Карху и Турва. Последние связаны с богатыми приезжими семьями, которые разбогатели на разработках нового вооружения и поставках их всем желающим. Карху же, по слухам, связаны с исконными правителями этих земель, которые пытаются пресечь экспансию Турва.

В Таре до недавнего времени правил местный князь, но в процессе переворота сформировался совет. По странному стечению обстоятельств в Совете заседают люди, связанные с Турва.

Орден Кормчих – один из самых древних орденов в регионе. По слухам имеет очень много влияния на все государства. Славится своими пророчествами, но никогда не предоставляет их по запросу, только отправляет своих адептов с ними, когда приходит нужное время.

ch.68cd61c59c3a8a12254b336b: 我听说你以前是个普通医生。你是怎么建立起这些人脉的？
ch.68cd61ee1652d4684c4e64cb: 作为医生，总会接触到形形色色的人。这是第一点。
ch.68cd61f38ef1869348b12c98: 年轻人，你没听过“好奇害死猫”这句话吗？
ch.68cd61f8465bd51cf8f97296: 人脉，年轻人，不是只靠工作就能得到的。
ch.68cd61fd83e7088b9cc5654f: 我的医院一直与最好的机构合作：
ch.68d00776332aa193dadb765e: 我还以为……算了，你需要什么？我们快点解决吧。
ch.68d008ec25919940c35dc5e6: 很好，不过我仍在等待结果。
ch.68d008f199f2d9fc43baf79b: 我明白了。好吧，我们来谈谈你需要什么。
ch.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: 我希望你之后能尽快完成任务。
ch.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: 你这样非常不专业。等全部完成后再来见我。
ch.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: 这不是我想听到的。我在等结果。
ch.68d0090997ccd17ef5bf2a56: 年轻人，我们这里办事是认真的。没有完成任务前不要来见我。
ch.68d0090e82568447e0fd2fa1: 这让我很不满意。我会等你带着完成的任务回来。
ch.68de9eca171f87ff0e958e25: 很遗憾，我现在没有什么能给你的。下次吧。
ch.6900db1604ccf706040c46e2: 其次，塔科夫发生那些……变化之前的事情，现在已经不重要了。
ch.6900db2a51d6e29c4054fd21: 我相信你完全明白我的意思。
ch.6900db36037f90942b993a66: Therapist 现在只是一个外号，之前的那个医生已经不存在了。不要问我关于她的事情。
ch.6900db5bb01c726d9b558ef1: 是的，我以前只是个普通医生，甚至还跑过外勤。
ch.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: 可以说，正是通过那些外勤，我认识了一些重要人物。
ch.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: 也许不是。总之，这不关你的事，年轻人。
ch.6900db81905dd04e80c4a4d9: 更准确地说，不止如此。如果你知道我为了到达现在这个位置付出了多少努力和时间就好了！
ch.6900db893684af2533eed2db: 不过，这依然与你无关。你是个可靠的人，但这还不足以让我向你讲述我的过去。
ch.6900dba751132eceef6afc10: 商业的、非营利的、政府的……
ch.6900dbb67906683aa0f2933d: 甚至包括我们的一些外国同行。
ch.6900dbbf1a18f00f54c73bbc: 想想看，我是在许多慈善活动中认识了不少客——
ch.6900dbd4b602595ef97eb582: 不管怎样，这对你有什么意义呢，年轻人？这些都是过去的事了。
ch.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: 我还没完成它。我需要更多时间。
ch.6914a8f9fe708db41b6176f4: 这批货又延误了……啊，你好，我刚刚没注意到你。

cz.68c42ae360dfb94d248bf57d: Tahle zásilka se zpozdila... Aha, zdravím, nevšiml jsem si tě.
cz.68c42cc20f4765dc79498706: Tady je všechno, co civilisti momentálně nepotřebujou.
cz.68c42cca564c00ececde4832: Vyber si. Ale upozorňuju, že léky se nevracejí.
cz.68c42d6b63f96898a7435f65: Budu rád, když tě uvidím příště.
cz.68c42d7c3a949abe1d59b2e4: Nezapomeň si sundat návleky na boty, až budeš odcházet.
cz.68cd60a208514ba103b46275: Vždycky se pro tebe něco najde, mladíku.
cz.68cd60a6d19357cdb9a3fa95: Pokusím se tě spojit s novýma úkolama.
cz.68cd60abe2acc6a7698a6678: Jsi spolehlivej člověk, takže pro tebe nějakou práci najdu.
cz.68cd60af137a654b5f720964: Podíváme se, třeba pro tebe něco najdu.
cz.68cd60b489da047fc6e47ae6: Zkontroluju svý záznamy. Zdálo se mi, že tam jsou nějaký nový úkoly.
cz.68cd60bac0907fd2841abf80: Rozhodl ses trochu si přivydělat? To je chvályhodný. Podíváme se, co se dá zařídit.
cz.68cd61c59c3a8a12254b336b: Slyšel jsem, že jsi býval normální doktor. Jak jsi získal všechny tyhle kontakty?
cz.68cd61ee1652d4684c4e64cb: Být doktorem vždycky obnáší spoustu kontaktů s různýma lidma. To je první věc.
cz.68cd61f38ef1869348b12c98: Mladíku, neslyšel jsi, že zvědavost zabila kočku?
cz.68cd61f8465bd51cf8f97296: Kontakty, mladíku, se nezískávají jenom v práci.
cz.68cd61fd83e7088b9cc5654f: Moje nemocnice vždycky spolupracovala s těma nejlepšíma nadacema:
cz.68d00776332aa193dadb765e: A já si myslel... Co potřebuješ? Ať to máme za sebou.
cz.68d008ec25919940c35dc5e6: Dobře, ale pořád čekám na výsledky.
cz.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: Doufám, že po tomhle úkol rychle dokončíš.
cz.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: Tohle je z tvojí strany velice neprofesionální. Vrať se, až bude všechno hotovo.
cz.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: Tohle slyšet nechci. Čekám na výsledky.
cz.68d0090997ccd17ef5bf2a56: Mladíku, jsme tu seriózní lidi. Nechoď za mnou, dokud nemáš hotovo.
cz.68d0090e82568447e0fd2fa1: To se neslyší dobře. Čekám tě s hotovým úkolem.
cz.68de9eca171f87ff0e958e25: Bohužel, nemám ti co nabídnout. Jindy.
cz.6900db1604ccf706040c46e2: Za druhý, co se stalo před těma... změnama v Tarkovu, už nehraje roli.
cz.6900db2a51d6e29c4054fd21: Věřím, že přesně chápeš, co tím myslím.
cz.6900db36037f90942b993a66: Ta terapeutka už neexistuje. Neptej se mě na ni.
cz.6900db5bb01c726d9b558ef1: Ano, byl jsem obyčejný doktor a dokonce jsem nějakou dobu jezdil na výjezdy.
cz.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: Dalo by se říct, že právě díky těm výjezdům jsem se seznámil s důležitými lidmi.
cz.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: Nebo možná ne. To se tě netýká, mladíku.
cz.6900db81905dd04e80c4a4d9: Přesněji řečeno, nejen tam. Kdybys věděl, kolik úsilí a času jsem vynaložil, abych dosáhl téhle pozice!
cz.6900db893684af2533eed2db: Nicméně, to se tě netýká. Jsi spolehlivý, ale to mi nestačí, abych ti vyprávěl o své minulosti.
cz.6900dbb67906683aa0f2933d: Dokonce i s našimi zahraničními kolegy.
cz.6900dbbf1a18f00f54c73bbc: Vezmi v potaz, že jsem na charitativních akcích potkal mnoho svých kli–
cz.6900dbd4b602595ef97eb582: Každopádně, jaký to má pro tebe význam, mladíku? To jsou záležitosti minulého života.
cz.6902381975e32f2c3b778b64: Zrovna jsem se na to chtěl zeptat...
cz.6902383eec1515f843ebef4a: Máš na sobě návleky na boty, doufám?
cz.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: Ještě jsem neskončil. Potřebuju víc času.
cz.6914a8f9fe708db41b6176f4: Tahle zásilka se zpozdila... Ah, zdravím, nevšiml jsem si tě.

it.68d0069f93fcf24f8e327470: Ho bisogno di una cosa da te...

it.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: Spero che finirai rapidamente il lavoro dopo questo.
it.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: Questo è molto poco professionale da parte tua. Torna quando avrai completato tutto.
it.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: Non è quello che voglio sentire. Sto aspettando i risultati.

it.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: Si potrebbe dire che è stato grazie a quelle telefonate che ho conosciuto persone importanti.
it.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: O forse no. Non sono affari tuoi, giovanotto.

it.6900db893684af2533eed2db: Tuttavia, non è affar tuo. Sei affidabile, ma questo non è sufficiente perché io ti racconti il mio passato.

it.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: Non ho ancora finito. Ho bisogno di più tempo.
it.69023955a691060827e0dd24: Ho bisogno di una cosa da te...

jp.682f27c443372dd58f0b774d: ごきげんよう、傭兵さん。
jp.68c42ae360dfb94d248bf57d: 荷物が遅れている... ああ、ごきげんよう、気づかなかったわ。
jp.68c42ae76299e35f0f01e884: こんにちは。何か急ぎかしら？
jp.68c42af418297b6614d64553: シューズカバーは着用してる？
jp.68c42cafc38ed941cde45f1e: 見ていってちょうだい。
jp.68c42cb6c9edf5ae31187bb7: 予備の物資がいくつかあるわ。
jp.68c42cc20f4765dc79498706: これは民間人には不要なものだわ。
jp.68c42cca564c00ececde4832: 好きなのを選んでいいわ。ただ、医薬品の返品は受け付けてないわ。
jp.68c42cd3ec4aa63faf64925f: 何探しているのかしら？
jp.68c42d6b63f96898a7435f65: また会えるのを楽しみにしてるわ。
jp.68c42d7767d9c46500f39a9d: いい取引だったわ。また来てね。
jp.68c42d7c3a949abe1d59b2e4: 出るときにシューズカバーを外すのを忘れないでね。
jp.68c42d82838478a4cbed8b94: 送迎は用意してるわ。安心して。
jp.68cd603772156078a473646c: 何か俺にできる仕事はないか？
jp.68cd60a208514ba103b46275: あなたには何でもあるわよ。傭兵さん。
jp.68cd60a6d19357cdb9a3fa95: 新しい依頼を持ってこれるように手配してみるわ。
jp.68cd60abe2acc6a7698a6678: あなたは信頼できるから、何か仕事を探してみるわね。
jp.68cd60af137a654b5f720964: なにか見つけられないか探してみるわ。
jp.68cd60b489da047fc6e47ae6: 記録を確認してみるわ。新しい依頼があったはず。
jp.68cd60bac0907fd2841abf80: 稼ぎたいと？いい心がけじゃない。できることがあったら手伝うわ。
jp.68cd61c59c3a8a12254b336b: 以前は普通の医者だったと聞いた。どうやってこんな人脈を作ったんだ？
jp.68cd61ee1652d4684c4e64cb: 医者というのは常に色んな人と関わるのよ。それが一つ。
jp.68cd61f38ef1869348b12c98: 傭兵さん、好奇心は猫を殺すという言葉を知らない？
jp.68cd61f8465bd51cf8f97296: 人脈というのは仕事だけで築けるものじゃないのよ。
jp.68cd61fd83e7088b9cc5654f: 私の病院は常に良い財団と協力してきたの。
jp.68cd66f4b29853abb952a312: すべて終わったかしら？
jp.68cd66faa2b9fdd00cf6057a: 戻るのが早かったわね。
jp.68d0069f93fcf24f8e327470: あなたにお願いしたいことがあるの…
jp.68d00776332aa193dadb765e: まさか... 何が必要なんだ？さっさと終わらせよう。
jp.68d008ec25919940c35dc5e6: いいわ。だけど私はまだ結果を待ってるわ。
jp.68d008f199f2d9fc43baf79b: わかった。それじゃあ必要なことについて話し合おう。
jp.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: この後、すぐ仕事を終わらせてくれることを願うわ。
jp.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: これはあなたにとっては専門外だわ。全部終わったら戻ってきてちょうだい。
jp.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: それは聞きたかった話じゃないわね。結果を待ってるわ。
jp.68d0090997ccd17ef5bf2a56: 傭兵さん、私たちは真剣なの。仕事を終わらせずに私のとこへ来ないでちょうだい。
jp.68d0090e82568447e0fd2fa1: それは聞きたかった話じゃないわね。私は仕事が終わったあなたを待ってるわ。
jp.68de9eca171f87ff0e958e25: 残念だけど... お願いできることはなにもないわ。また今度ね。
jp.6900db1604ccf706040c46e2: 第二に、タルコフにおける… 変化より前に起こったことは、もはや重要ではないわ。
jp.6900db2a51d6e29c4054fd21: あなたは私の言うことを理解しているはずだわ。
jp.6900db36037f90942b993a66: あのセラピストはもういないのよ。彼女について聞かないでちょうだい。
jp.6900db5bb01c726d9b558ef1: ええ、私は普通の医者だったわ。しばらくは緊急の呼び出しにも行っていたの。
jp.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: そうした電話を通じて、重要な人々と知り合うことができたとも言えるでしょうね。
jp.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: あるいは違うかも。それはあなたには関係ないわね。傭兵さん。
jp.6900db81905dd04e80c4a4d9: もっと正確に言うなら、それだけじゃないわ。私がこの地位にたどり着くために、どれほどの労力と時間を費やしたか、あなたが知っていたら！
jp.6900db893684af2533eed2db: とはいえ、それはあなたの知ったことじゃないわね。あなたは信頼できるけど、それでも私が過去のことを打ち明けるには十分じゃないわ。
jp.6900dbb67906683aa0f2933d: 外国人の同僚たちでさえも。
jp.6900dbbf1a18f00f54c73bbc: 私は慈善イベント多くの顧─
jp.6900dbd4b602595ef97eb582: いずれにせよ、あなたにとって何の違いがあるのかしら、傭兵さん？これは過去の人生の問題なの。
jp.6902381975e32f2c3b778b64: ちょうどこれについて聞こうとしていたの...
jp.6902383eec1515f843ebef4a: シューズカバーは着用してる？
jp.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: まだ終わっていないわ。もう少し時間が必要ね。
jp.69023955a691060827e0dd24: あなたにお願いしたいことがあるの…
jp.6914a8f9fe708db41b6176f4: 荷物が遅れている... ああ、ごきげんよう、気づかなかったわ。

tu.68c42ae360dfb94d248bf57d: Bu sevkiyat gecikmiş… Ah, selamlar, seni fark etmemiştim.
tu.68c42ae76299e35f0f01e884: Merhaba. Acil bir durum mu var?
tu.68c42cc20f4765dc79498706: Burada sivillerin şu anda ihtiyaç duymadığı her şey var.
tu.68c42cca564c00ececde4832: Seç beğen. Ama lütfen unutma, ilaçların iadesi yoktur.
tu.68c42d6b63f96898a7435f65: Seni bir dahaki sefere görmekten memnun olurum.
tu.68cd603772156078a473646c: Bende yapacak bir iş var mı?
tu.68cd60a208514ba103b46275: Senin için her zaman bir şeyler vardır, genç adam.
tu.68cd60abe2acc6a7698a6678: Güvenilir birisin, o yüzden sana mutlaka bir iş bulurum.
tu.68cd60af137a654b5f720964: Bakalım, senin için bir şey bulabilir miyim.
tu.68cd60b489da047fc6e47ae6: Kayıtlarıma bakacağım. Yeni görevler var gibiydi.
tu.68cd60bac0907fd2841abf80: Biraz ek gelir mi istedin? İyi bir girişim. Bakalım ne ayarlayabiliriz.
tu.68cd61c59c3a8a12254b336b: Bir zamanlar normal bir doktormuşsun. Bu kadar bağlantıyı nasıl kurdun?
tu.68cd61ee1652d4684c4e64cb: Doktor olmak her zaman birçok insanla temas kurmayı gerektirir. Bu birinci nokta.
tu.68cd61f38ef1869348b12c98: Genç adam, merakın kediyi öldürdüğünü duymadın mı?
tu.68cd61f8465bd51cf8f97296: Bağlantılar, genç adam, yalnızca iş yerinde kazanılmaz.
tu.68cd61fd83e7088b9cc5654f: Hastanem her zaman en iyi vakıflarla iş birliği yapmıştır:
tu.68d00776332aa193dadb765e: Ben de tam… Neyse, ne istiyorsun? Hadi halledelim.
tu.68d008f199f2d9fc43baf79b: Anlıyorum. Peki, neye ihtiyacın var konuşalım.
tu.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: Umarım bundan sonra görevi hızlıca tamamlarsın.
tu.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: Bu yaptığın hiç profesyonel değil. Her şey tamamlanınca geri dön.
tu.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: Duymak istediğim bu değildi. Sonuçları bekliyorum.
tu.68d0090997ccd17ef5bf2a56: Genç adam, burada ciddi insanlarız. Görev tamamlanmadan yanıma gelme.
tu.68d0090e82568447e0fd2fa1: Bu hoş bir durum değil. Görev tamamlanmış halde seni bekliyor olacağım.
tu.68de9eca171f87ff0e958e25: Ne yazık ki sana sunacak bir şeyim yok. Başka bir zaman.
tu.6900db1604ccf706040c46e2: İkincisi, Tarkov’daki… değişikliklerden önce olanların artık hiçbir önemi yok.
tu.6900db2a51d6e29c4054fd21: Neyi kastettiğimi gayet iyi anladığını düşünüyorum.
tu.6900db36037f90942b993a66: O terapist artık yok. Bana ondan bahsetme.
tu.6900db5bb01c726d9b558ef1: Evet, sıradan bir doktordum ve bir süre ev ziyaretlerine de giderdim.
tu.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: Denebilir ki önemli insanlarla o ziyaretler sayesinde tanıştım.
tu.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: Ya da belki de değil. Bu seni ilgilendirmez, genç adam.
tu.6900db81905dd04e80c4a4d9: Daha doğrusu, yalnızca orada değil. Bu konuma gelmek için ne kadar emek ve zaman harcadığımı bilsen!
tu.6900db893684af2533eed2db: Yine de, bu seni ilgilendirmez. Güvenilir birisin ama geçmişimi sana anlatacak kadar değil.
tu.6900dba751132eceef6afc10: Ticari, kâr amacı gütmeyen, devlet kurumları…
tu.6900dbbf1a18f00f54c73bbc: Birçok hastamla hayır etkinliklerinde tanıştığımı düşün…
tu.6900dbd4b602595ef97eb582: Her neyse, genç adam, tüm bunların sana ne faydası var? Bunlar eski bir hayatın meseleleri.
tu.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: Henüz bitirmedim. Biraz daha zamana ihtiyacım var.
tu.6914a8f9fe708db41b6176f4: Bu sevkiyat gecikmiş… Ah, selamlar, seni fark etmemiştim.

ru.682f27c443372dd58f0b7751: Что у вас есть на продажу?
ru.68c42ae360dfb94d248bf57d: Так, эта поставка задерживается… А, здравствуйте, я вас не заметила.
ru.68c42cc20f4765dc79498706: Всё, что не требуется сейчас гражданским.
ru.68c42cca564c00ececde4832: Выбирайте. Но учтите, что медикаменты возврату не подлежат.
ru.68c42d6b63f96898a7435f65: Буду рада увидеть вас в следующий раз.
ru.68c42d7767d9c46500f39a9d: С вами приятно иметь дело. Заходите ещё.
ru.68c42d7c3a949abe1d59b2e4: Не забудьте снять бахилы на выходе.
ru.68cd60a208514ba103b46275: Для вас, юноша, всегда что-то найдётся.
ru.68cd60a6d19357cdb9a3fa95: Постараюсь подключить вас к новым заданиям.
ru.68cd60abe2acc6a7698a6678: Вы человек надёжный, сейчас найду для вас работу.
ru.68cd60af137a654b5f720964: Давайте посмотрим, может найдётся что-то для вас.
ru.68cd60b489da047fc6e47ae6: Сейчас посмотрю по своим записям. Вроде были новые задания.
ru.68cd60bac0907fd2841abf80: Решили подзаработать? Дело хорошее. Сейчас что-нибудь придумаем.
ru.68cd61c59c3a8a12254b336b: Слышал, вы раньше были обычным врачом. Откуда тогда связи?
ru.68cd61ee1652d4684c4e64cb: Работа врачом всегда подразумевает много контактов с разными людьми. Это во-первых.
ru.68cd61f38ef1869348b12c98: Молодой человек, вам не рассказывали, что любопытство кошку сгубило?
ru.68cd61f8465bd51cf8f97296: Связи, молодой человек, добываются не на работе.
ru.68cd61fd83e7088b9cc5654f: Моя больница всегда сотрудничала с лучшими фондами:
ru.68d00776332aa193dadb765e: А я уж подумала… Что требуется? Давайте закончим побыстрее.
ru.68d008ec25919940c35dc5e6: Хорошо, но выполненное задание я всё равно жду.
ru.68d008f199f2d9fc43baf79b: Понятно. Что ж, давайте обсудим, что вам требуется.
ru.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: Надеюсь, после вы быстро завершите начатое.
ru.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: Это очень непрофессионально с вашей стороны. Возвращайтесь, как всё сделаете.
ru.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: Я не это хочу услышать. Жду результат.
ru.68d0090997ccd17ef5bf2a56: Юноша, ну мы же серьёзные люди. Не приходите ко мне без выполненного задания.
ru.68d0090e82568447e0fd2fa1: Неприятно это слышать. Жду вас с выполненной задачей.
ru.68de9eca171f87ff0e958e25: К сожалению, пока ничего нет. Зайдите позже.
ru.6900db1604ccf706040c46e2: Во-вторых, то, что было до… изменений в Таркове, сейчас не имеет значения.
ru.6900db2a51d6e29c4054fd21: Думаю, вы точно понимаете о чём я.
ru.6900db36037f90942b993a66: Того терапевта уже не существует. Не стоит спрашивать меня о ней.
ru.6900db5bb01c726d9b558ef1: Да, я была самым обычным врачом, какое-то время даже на вызовы выезжала.
ru.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: Можно сказать, что именно на них я и познакомилась с важными людьми.
ru.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: А может и нет. Вас, юноша, это не касается.
ru.6900db81905dd04e80c4a4d9: Точнее, не только там. Знали бы вы, сколько я потратила сил и времени, чтобы оказаться здесь, на этом месте!
ru.6900db893684af2533eed2db: Впрочем, вас это не касается. Вы человек надёжный, но этого недостаточно, чтобы я вам рассказывала про своё прошлое.
ru.6900dbbf1a18f00f54c73bbc: Считайте, на благотворительных вечерах и познакомилась со многими своими поку…
ru.6900dbd4b602595ef97eb582: В любом случае, какая вам разница, молодой человек? Это дела из прошлой жизни.
ru.6902381975e32f2c3b778b64: Я как раз пришёл уточнить насчёт нашего дела...
ru.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: Я пока не всё сделал. Мне нужно ещё время.
ru.6914a8f9fe708db41b6176f4: Так, эта поставка задерживается… А, здравствуйте, я вас не заметила.

ro.68c42d82838478a4cbed8b94: You’ll be escorted, do not worry.
ro.68cd60a208514ba103b46275: There is always something for you, young man.
ro.68cd60a6d19357cdb9a3fa95: I will try to connect you with the new assignments.
ro.68cd60abe2acc6a7698a6678: You are a reliable person, so I will find some work for you.
ro.68cd60af137a654b5f720964: Let us see, perhaps I can find something for you.
ro.68cd60b489da047fc6e47ae6: I will check my records. There seemed to be some new assignments.
ro.68cd60bac0907fd2841abf80: Decided to earn a little extra? That is a good endeavor. Let us see what we can arrange.
ro.68cd61c59c3a8a12254b336b: I heard you used to be a regular doctor before. How did you make all these connections?
ro.68cd61ee1652d4684c4e64cb: Being a doctor always entails numerous contacts with various people. That is the first point.
ro.68cd61f38ef1869348b12c98: Young man, have you not heard that curiosity killed the cat?
ro.68cd61f8465bd51cf8f97296: Connections, young man, are not acquired solely at work.
ro.68cd61fd83e7088b9cc5654f: My hospital has always collaborated with the best foundations:
ro.68d00776332aa193dadb765e: And here I thought… What do you need? Let's get this over with.
ro.68d008ec25919940c35dc5e6: Good, however I am still awaiting the results.
ro.68d008f199f2d9fc43baf79b: I see. Well, let's discuss what you need.
ro.68d008f434953682c7cc1498: I am hoping you will finish the assignment quick after this.
ro.68d00901d8b5560dafa2a27c: This is very unprofessional on your part. Return once all is completed.
ro.68d00905e60ac72598f87250: That is not what I wish to hear. I am awaiting the results.
ro.68d0090997ccd17ef5bf2a56: Young man, we are serious people here. Do not come to me without the completed task.
ro.68d0090e82568447e0fd2fa1: That is unpleasant to hear. I am awaiting you with the completed task.
ro.68de9eca171f87ff0e958e25: Unfortunately, I have nothing to offer you. Another time.
ro.6900db1604ccf706040c46e2: Secondly, what occurred before the… changes in Tarkov, no longer matters.
ro.6900db2a51d6e29c4054fd21: I believe you understand exactly what I mean.
ro.6900db36037f90942b993a66: That therapist no longer exists. Do not ask me about her.
ro.6900db5bb01c726d9b558ef1: Yes, I was an ordinary doctor, and even went on calls for some time.
ro.6900db655e287f6b9859bc95: One could say that it was through those calls that I became acquainted with important people.
ro.6900db6d47be918cc199926a: Or perhaps not. That is none of your concern, young man.
ro.6900db81905dd04e80c4a4d9: More precisely, not only there. If you knew how much effort and time I expended to reach this position!
ro.6900db893684af2533eed2db: Nevertheless, it is none of your concern. You are reliable, but that is not sufficient for me to recount my past to you.
ro.6900dbbf1a18f00f54c73bbc: Consider that it was at charitable events that I met many of my cli–
ro.6900dbd4b602595ef97eb582: In any case, what difference does it make to you, young man? These are matters of a past life.
ro.6902381975e32f2c3b778b64: I was just about to ask about this…
ro.6902383eec1515f843ebef4a: You are wearing shoe covers, I hope?
ro.690238a06473e088b985ed6d: I'm not finished with it yet. I need more time.

ch.693af08b07098f646ff43bc4: 最近怎么样？BTR 跑得还顺畅吧？

ch.693af08bb774d120d8139aff: 你真是个了不起的家伙！我欠你一个人情。
ch.693af08bc4007328af24ad89:
试过我的新加热器没？这个小东西可是好用极了！不过人是暖和起来了，BTR 上路又成了大麻烦……我得热车热上一个小时才能勉强让引擎正常运转，这还没算发动引擎的那通折腾呢！

这台老姑娘一开始根本不肯在大冷天启动。柴油机光冒烟不出力，嚎了半天也打不着。得把燃油添加剂的量翻倍才能勉强转起来，但你也知道的，在封锁区里，货物可不会自己从架子上长出来。所以手头的库存是用一罐少一罐。

呃，你能帮帮忙吗？就当是帮朋友一个小忙。既然你没在藏身处里猫冬，那应该在外头见到过一些燃油添加剂吧？这东西对你来说也许没有太大用场，但放在我这可是和救命一样啊。

jp.693af08bc4007328af24ad89:
新しいヒーターは試したか？このちっちゃい奴はしっかり使えるぞ！だが今のルートで外に出るのは別の話だ... エンジンを一時間暖気しないとダメなんだ、それにエンジンの始動は含めちゃいないんだ。

なあ、友達を助けちゃくれないか？今地下に隠れてはないんだ、フューエルコンディショナーを探せばいいんだ。お前には要らないかもしれないけど、俺には大助かりなんだ。

ch.693afca45e2da1175e69f74a:
干得漂亮！我已经回去过几次基地了，也自己瞧了瞧周围的情况。我都快记不清基地上一回这么安静是在什么时候了。

我给你准备了些谢礼。给，拿着吧。
ch.693afca4a5fc823d652e0c71:
我正等着你上门呢！虽然外头冰天雪地，我这儿可是有加热器护身——生意好到不能再好。PMC 们简直是排着队赶着搭车，免得冻僵在雪地里头，或者至少上车暖和一会。相信我，这可比给其他商人跑腿赚的多得多啦！

所以我故意放出话去，就说我的 BTR 坏了，免得哪个商人又想用什么合同把我给困住。还是自己给自己打工最畅快，至少还能帮帮路边的普通人，而不是像头牲口一样疲于奔命。但有一个问题。

近些天我没怎么回基地，但我总得时不时往回跑一趟。有些挺宝贵的设备还放在仓库里，没法一次性全部转移走。要是我那些“合作伙伴”的狗腿们听到风声开始在四周探头探脑，那就全完了！

所以我又得请你帮忙了。去我的基地看看，把不相干的人都赶走，成吗？不过别碰 PMC！他们现在可是我的大客户了，要是惹毛了他们，我可是吃不了兜着走。
ch.693afca4badd7b026b3e78c6: 听起来还成。我只希望去帮你赶走那些混混的时候别被冻死在外边。
ch.693afca4be50afd53ea8e85e: 都按照你说的办完了，那些 Scav 近期应该没那个胆子再在你的营地探头探脑了。
ch.693afca4cff1b19615498c4b: 燃料怎么样了？没有新的问题吧？

cz.693afca45e2da1175e69f74a:
Nice one! I've checked out the Depot a couple times already, saw it all with my own eyes. It's been a long time since it was that quiet there.

I've got something ready for you as a thank you. Here, take it.
cz.693afca4a5fc823d652e0c71:
I was waiting for you! With these frosts and the new heater, business has been booming like never before. PMCs are lining up just to warm up or catch a ride somewhere. And trust me, that's a lot easier and more profitable than running under the traders.

So I started a rumor that my BTR was down, just to keep them from dragging me into their contracts. Figured I'd work for myself for a bit, help out the regular folks too. Only one problem though.

I don't hit the Depot often these days, but I can't avoid it completely. There's a bunch of important equipment still there, stuff you can't just move in one go. And if any rats from my "partner's" crew start snooping around, the whole thing goes to hell.

So I need your help again. Make sure there are no extra eyes in the Depot, yeah? Just don't touch the PMCs! They're my main customers right now, they won't rat me out.
cz.693afca4badd7b026b3e78c6: Sounds good. Hope I don't get too cold sitting there guarding your place.
cz.693afca4be50afd53ea8e85e: Did all you asked. I doubt the regular Scavs will come snooping around any time soon.

J’ai préparé quelque chose pour te remercier. Tiens, prends ça.
fr.693afca4a5fc823d652e0c71:
Je t’attendais ! Avec ces gelées et le nouveau chauffage, les affaires tournent à plein régime. Les opérateurs font la queue juste pour se réchauffer ou choper un trajet quelque part. Et crois-moi, c’est bien plus simple et rentable que de courir sous les ordres des marchands.

Alors j’ai lancé une rumeur comme quoi mon BTR était en panne, histoire qu’ils arrêtent de m’entraîner dans leurs contrats. Je me suis dit que je bosserais pour moi un moment, en aidant aussi les gens normaux. Un seul problème, par contre.

Je ne vais plus souvent au Dépôt ces temps-ci, mais je ne peux pas l’éviter complètement. Il y a encore pas mal d’équipement important là-bas, des trucs impossibles à déplacer en une seule fois. Et si des rats de l’équipe de mon « partenaire » commencent à fouiner, tout part en vrille.

J’ai donc encore besoin de ton aide. Assure-toi qu’il n’y ait pas d’yeux en trop au dépôt, d’accord ? Ne touche juste pas aux opérateurs ! Ce sont mes principaux clients en ce moment, ils ne me balanceront pas.
fr.693afca4badd7b026b3e78c6: Ça marche. J’espère juste ne pas geler sur place en gardant ton coin.
fr.693afca4be50afd53ea8e85e: J’ai fait tout ce que tu as demandé. Je doute que les scavs habituels viennent fouiner de nouveau de sitôt.
fr.693afca4cff1b19615498c4b: Comment est ton carburant ? Pas de nouveaux soucis ?
fr.693afca4efd63f69d6bd0810: Je n’ai jamais douté de toi.
fr.693afca4f85df3036c49e07c: Je n’ai jamais douté de toi.

jp.693afca45e2da1175e69f74a:
やるな！倉庫を何度か確認したぞ、俺の目でな。ここが静かなのは久しぶりだ。

感謝の印としてあるものを用意した。ほら、持っていきな。
jp.693afca4a5fc823d652e0c71:
待ってたぞ！凍結と新しいヒーターのおかげで、ビジネスは今までになく好調だ。PMC 達は暖まるため、どこかに乗り込むために並んでる。信じてくれよ、トレーダーの下で走るよりもずっと簡単で利益が出るんだ。

それで、BTR が動かなくなったっていう噂を俺は流したんだ。トレーダーたちが俺に契約させるのを防ぐためにな。自分の為に働いて、一般人の助けにもなろうと思ったんだ。だが一つ問題がある。

最近は倉庫にあまり行ってないんだが、完全に避けるわけにはいかない。まだ重要な装備がたくさんあるし、一度に輸送するわけにもいかない。それにだ、もし「パートナーさん」のクルーがこっそり嗅ぎまわり始めたら、全て台無しだ。

だからまた助けてくれ。倉庫に余計な奴らの目が回らないようにしてほしい、できるか？PMC には手を出さないでくれよ！彼らは今の俺の主なお客さんなんだ、俺のことの密告はしないはずだ。
jp.693afca4badd7b026b3e78c6: いいじゃないか。お前があんたの家を守っているあいだに凍えなければいいけどな。
jp.693afca4be50afd53ea8e85e: あんたに頼まれたことはすべてやったぞ。そこらの Scav がすぐに詮索しに来ることはないはずだ。
jp.693afca4cff1b19615498c4b: 燃料はどうだ？新しい問題はないか？
jp.693afca4efd63f69d6bd0810: そう言うと信じてたぞ。
jp.693afca4f85df3036c49e07c: そう言うと信じてたぞ。

kr.693afca45e2da1175e69f74a:
잘했다! 나도 보급창고를 몇 번 직접 확인했는데, 이렇게 조용한 건 정말 오랜만이야.

고마운 의미로 준비한 게 있다. 여기, 받아.
kr.693afca4a5fc823d652e0c71:
기다리고 있었지! 이 추위랑 새 히터 덕분에 장사가 요즘 최고야. PMC들이 몸 녹이거나 태워달라고 줄을 서고 있거든. 믿어라, 상인들 밑에서 굴러다니는 것보다 훨씬 편하고 돈도 된다.

그래서 일부러 BTR 고장 났다는 소문을 퍼뜨렸다. 계약에 끌려들어가기 싫어서 말이지. 당분간은 내 방식대로 일하면서, 일반 사람들도 좀 도와주려고.

문제는 하나다.
요즘은 보급창고를 자주 안 가지만, 완전히 피할 순 없어. 한 번에 옮길 수 없는 중요한 장비들이 아직 남아 있거든. 그런데 내 ‘파트너’ 쪽 쥐새끼들이 눈치라도 채면 전부 끝이다.

그래서 또 네 도움이 필요하다. 보급창고에 쓸데없는 눈들이 없는지 확인해줘. PMC는 건드리지 마라! 지금 내 주 고객들이고, 밀고할 놈들도 아니다.
kr.693afca4badd7b026b3e78c6: 괜찮네. 여기 앉아서 지키다 얼어 죽지만 않으면 되겠지.
kr.693afca4be50afd53ea8e85e: 부탁한 건 다 했다. 일반 스캐브들이 다시 기웃댈 일은 없을 거다.
kr.693afca4cff1b19615498c4b: 연료는 어때? 또 문제 생긴 건 아니지?

ru.693afca4a5fc823d652e0c71:
А я тебя ждал! С этими морозами и новой печкой у меня дела так попёрли, как никогда не было! ЧВК чуть ли не очередями заходят, чтобы отогреться или добраться куда надо. А это, знаешь, куда проще и выгоднее, чем под торгашами ходить.

Вот я и пустил слушок, что машина моя встала, чтобы они со своими контрактами не лезли. А я пока на себя поработаю спокойно, да простому народу вон помогу. Есть только одна проблема.

Я сейчас хоть и нечасто в Депо бываю, но совсем без заездов туда никак не обойтись. Там осталась куча нужного оборудования, которое так просто не перевезёшь. И если там будет крысить кто-то из подчинённых моего контрагента, всё медным тазом накроется. 

Так что снова твоя помощь нужна: проконтролируй, чтобы в Депо не было лишних глаз, лады? Главное ЧВК не трогай! Они сейчас мои главные клиенты, да и сдавать меня не будут.
ru.693afca4badd7b026b3e78c6: Звучит несложно, главное не замёрзнуть, пока на дозоре буду стоять.
